                "content": "package provider\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"os/exec\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"strings\"\n)\n\n// kiroProvider implements Provider for the kiro-cli tool.\ntype kiroProvider struct {\n\thome string\n}\n\n// compile-time assertion that kiroProvider satisfies Provider (like Java's\n// \"implements\", but checked structurally by the compiler).\nvar _ Provider = (*kiroProvider)(nil)\n\n// NewKiro returns a Provider backed by kiro-cli.\nfunc NewKiro() Provider {\n\thome, _ := os.UserHomeDir()\n\treturn &kiroProvider{home: home}\n}\n\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) Name() string { return \"kiro-cli\" }\n\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) SessionsDir() string {\n\treturn filepath.Join(k.home, \".kiro\", \"sessions\", \"cli\")\n}\n\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) agentsDir() string {\n\treturn filepath.Join(k.home, \".kiro\", \"agents\")\n}\n\n// buildTmuxCommand wraps an inner command line in a tmux session (rooted at\n// dir) with taco's standard bindings, matching how repo sessions are launched.\nfunc buildTmuxCommand(tmuxName, dir, inner string) *exec.Cmd {\n\tscript := fmt.Sprintf(`tmux new-session -A -s %s -c %s \\\n   \"tmux bind-key -n Escape run 'if \\\n   [ #{pane_current_command} != vi ] && \\\n   [ #{pane_current_command} != vim ] && \\\n   [ #{pane_current_command} != nvim ] && \\\n   [ #{pane_current_command} != k9s ] && \\\n   [ #{pane_current_command} != git ]; \\\n   then tmux detach; \\\n   else tmux send-keys Escape; fi'; \\\n   tmux set-option -g escape-time 0; \\\n   tmux set -g mouse on; \\\n   %s\"`, tmuxName, dir, inner)\n\treturn exec.Command(\"sh\", \"-c\", script)\n}\n\n// StartCommand starts a new kiro-cli chat in dir with the given agent.\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) StartCommand(dir, agent string) *exec.Cmd {\n\tinner := \"kiro-cli\"\n\tif agent != \"\" {\n\t\tinner = fmt.Sprintf(\"kiro-cli --agent %s\", shellQuote(agent))\n\t}\n\t// tmux session name derived from the directory (sanitised).\n\tname := \"taco-chat-\" + sanitize(filepath.Base(dir))\n\treturn buildTmuxCommand(name, dir, inner)\n}\n\n// ResumeCommand resumes an existing kiro-cli chat by session id.\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) ResumeCommand(sessionID string) *exec.Cmd {\n\tdir := k.SessionCWD(sessionID)\n\tif dir == \"\" {\n\t\tdir = k.home\n\t}\n\tinner := fmt.Sprintf(\"kiro-cli chat --resume-id %s\", shellQuote(sessionID))\n\tname := \"taco-chat-\" + sanitize(sessionID)\n\treturn buildTmuxCommand(name, dir, inner)\n}\n\n// Agents lists available agent names (the *.json file stems in agentsDir),\n// skipping non-agent files.\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) Agents() ([]string, error) {\n\tentries, err := os.ReadDir(k.agentsDir())\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tagents := make([]string, 0, len(entries))\n\tfor _, e := range entries {\n\t\tname := e.Name()\n\t\tif e.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, \".json\") {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif strings.HasSuffix(name, \".json.example\") || strings.HasPrefix(name, \".\") {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tagents = append(agents, strings.TrimSuffix(name, \".json\"))\n\t}\n\tsort.Strings(agents)\n\treturn agents, nil\n}\n\n// SessionSnapshot returns the set of existing session IDs (json file stems).\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) SessionSnapshot() (map[string]bool, error) {\n\tids := map[string]bool{}\n\tentries, err := os.ReadDir(k.SessionsDir())\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn ids, err\n\t}\n\tfor _, e := range entries {\n\t\tif strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), \".json\") {\n\t\t\tids[strings.TrimSuffix(e.Name(), \".json\")] = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn ids, nil\n}\n\n// sessionMeta is the subset of a kiro session file taco reads.\ntype sessionMeta struct {\n\tSessionID            string `json:\"session_id\"`\n\tCWD                  string `json:\"cwd\"`\n\tTitle                string `json:\"title\"`\n\tSessionCreatedReason string `json:\"session_created_reason\"`\n\tUpdatedAt            string `json:\"updated_at\"`\n}\n\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) readMeta(sessionID string) (sessionMeta, bool) {\n\tvar m sessionMeta\n\tdata, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(k.SessionsDir(), sessionID+\".json\"))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn m, false\n\t}\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &m); err != nil {\n\t\treturn m, false\n\t}\n\treturn m, true\n}\n\n// DetectNewSession finds a session that appeared since the snapshot whose cwd\n// matches dir, preferring a non-subagent (top-level) session and the most\n// recently updated one.\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) DetectNewSession(before map[string]bool, dir string) (string, bool) {\n\tentries, err := os.ReadDir(k.SessionsDir())\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", false\n\t}\n\n\tvar best sessionMeta\n\tfound := false\n\tfor _, e := range entries {\n\t\tif !strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), \".json\") {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tid := strings.TrimSuffix(e.Name(), \".json\")\n\t\tif before[id] {\n\t\t\tcontinue // existed before launch\n\t\t}\n\t\tm, ok := k.readMeta(id)\n\t\tif !ok || m.CWD != dir {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Prefer a non-subagent session; among those, the latest updated.\n\t\tif !found {\n\t\t\tbest, found = m, true\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tbestSub := best.SessionCreatedReason == \"subagent\"\n\t\tcurSub := m.SessionCreatedReason == \"subagent\"\n\t\tif bestSub && !curSub {\n\t\t\tbest = m // prefer top-level over subagent\n\t\t} else if bestSub == curSub && m.UpdatedAt > best.UpdatedAt {\n\t\t\tbest = m\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif !found {\n\t\treturn \"\", false\n\t}\n\treturn best.SessionID, true\n}\n\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) SessionTitle(sessionID string) string {\n\tm, ok := k.readMeta(sessionID)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\treturn m.Title\n}\n\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) SessionCWD(sessionID string) string {\n\tm, ok := k.readMeta(sessionID)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\treturn m.CWD\n}\n\n// shellQuote single-quotes a string for safe inclusion in a shell command.\nfunc shellQuote(s string) string {\n\treturn \"'\" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, \"'\", `'\\''`) + \"'\"\n}\n\n// sanitize makes a string safe as a tmux session name (no dots/colons/spaces).\nfunc sanitize(s string) string {\n\tr := strings.NewReplacer(\".\", \"_\", \":\", \"_\", \" \", \"_\", \"/\", \"_\")\n\treturn r.Replace(s)\n}\n",

    string `json:\"updated_at\"`\n}\n\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) readMeta(sessionID string) (sessionMeta, bool) {\n\tvar m sessionMeta\n\tdata, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(k.SessionsDir(), sessionID+\".json\"))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn m, false\n\t}\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &m); err != nil {\n\t\treturn m, false\n\t}\n\treturn m, true\n}\n\n// DetectNewSession finds a session that appeared since the snapshot whose cwd\n// matches dir, preferring a non-subagent (top-level) session and the most\n// recently updated one.\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) DetectNewSession(before map[string]bool, dir string) (string, bool) {\n\tentries, err := os.ReadDir(k.SessionsDir())\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", false\n\t}\n\n\tvar best sessionMeta\n\tfound := false\n\tfor _, e := range entries {\n\t\tif !strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), \".json\") {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tid := strings.TrimSuffix(e.Name(), \".json\")\n\t\tif before[id] {\n\t\t\tcontinue // existed before launch\n\t\t}\n\t\tm, ok := k.readMeta(id)\n\t\tif !ok || m.CWD != dir {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Prefer a non-subagent session; among those, the latest updated.\n\t\tif !found {\n\t\t\tbest, found = m, true\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tbestSub := best.SessionCreatedReason == \"subagent\"\n\t\tcurSub := m.SessionCreatedReason == \"subagent\"\n\t\tif bestSub && !curSub {\n\t\t\tbest = m // prefer top-level over subagent\n\t\t} else if bestSub == curSub && m.UpdatedAt > best.UpdatedAt {\n\t\t\tbest = m\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif !found {\n\t\treturn \"\", false\n\t}\n\treturn best.SessionID, true\n}\n\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) SessionTitle(sessionID string) string {\n\tm, ok := k.readMeta(sessionID)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\treturn m.Title\n}\n\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) SessionCWD(sessionID string) string {\n\tm, ok := k.readMeta(sessionID)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\treturn m.CWD\n}\n\n// shellQuote single-quotes a string for safe inclusion in a shell command.\nfunc shellQuote(s string) string {\n\treturn \"'\" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, \"'\", `'\\''`) + \"'\"\n}\n\n// sanitize makes a string safe as a tmux session name (no dots/colons/spaces).\nfunc sanitize(s string) string {\n\tr := strings.NewReplacer(\".\", \"_\", \":\", \"_\", \" \", \"_\", \"/\", \"_\")\n\treturn r.Replace(s)\n}\n"

            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Stage 1 verified against your real system:\n- **Agents** listed correctly — all 13 real agents (`analyzer`, `worker`, `design-orchestrator`, etc.), with `.DS_Store`, `agent_config.json.example`, and the subdirectory properly skipped.\n- **Session snapshot** read 263 sessions from `~/.kiro/sessions/cli`, and title/cwd reads work against the real JSON format.\n\nThe provider interface + kiro implementation is done and working. On return, snapshot-diff to capture the new session id, write the entry.\n- **Enter** on an existing chat → resume via `provider.ResumeCommand`.\n\nOne thing I want to flag now rather than later: the new-chat flow chains **two modals** (agent picker, then directory browser) before launching.           {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Proceeding. Note I'll go with the defaults I proposed: chat tmux sessions are separate (`taco-chat-*`) and persist across taco exits (so you can resume).\n\n**Stage 2 — the `chats` package.** Mirrors `repos`, persisting `~/.taco/chats` as `chatName#sessionID`:"
          },
          {
            "kind": "toolUse",
            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "toolu_bdrk_01BNyurZGTFx9aA3KKSf2CQH",
              "name": "write",
              "input": {
                "__tool_use_purpose": "Create the chats persistence package mirroring the repos pattern.",
                "command": "create",
                "content": "// Package chats persists the list of chat sessions taco knows about, so they\n// can be resumed later. Each entry pairs a fallback name with a provider\n// session id; the live display title is resolved from the provider at render\n// time (see the ui package).\npackage chats\n\nimport (\n\t\"bufio\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"strings\"\n)\n\n// Chat is a saved chat session.\ntype Chat struct {\n\t// Name is a persisted fallback label (used when the provider has no live\n\t// title yet).\n\tName string\n\t// SessionID identifies the chat in the provider (e.g. kiro session id).\n\tSessionID string\n\t// Session is the tmux session handle while the chat is running, or nil.\n\tSession *string\n}\n\n// Instance is the global list of saved chats.\nvar Instance []*Chat\n\nvar filePath string\n\n// Init loads chats from ~/.taco/chats, creating the directory if needed.\nfunc Init() error {\n\thome, err := os.UserHomeDir()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tfilePath = filepath.Join(home, \".taco\", \"chats\")\n\n\tif err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(filePath), 0755); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tchats, err := load()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tInstance = chats\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc load() ([]*Chat, error) {\n\tlist := make([]*Chat, 0)\n\n\tf, err := os.Open(filePath)\n\tif os.IsNotExist(err) {\n\t\treturn list, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tdefer f.Close()\n\n\tscanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)\n\tfor scanner.Scan() {\n\t\tline := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())\n\t\tif line == \"\" {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Format: name#sessionID.\n\t\tname, id, found := strings.Cut(line, \"#\")\n\t\tif !found {\n\t\t\t// No '#': treat the whole line as the session id.\n\t\t\tid = name\n\t\t}\n\t\tlist = append(list, &Chat{Name: name, SessionID: id})\n\t}\n\treturn list, scanner.Err()\n}\n\nfunc save() error {\n\tvar b strings.Builder\n\n\tsorted := make([]*Chat, len(Instance))\n\tcopy(sorted, Instance)\n\tsort.Slice(sorted, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\treturn sorted[i].Name < sorted[j].Name\n\t})\n\n\tfor _, c := range sorted {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(&b, \"%s#%s\\n\", c.Name, c.SessionID)\n\t}\n\n\ttmp := filePath + \".tmp\"\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(tmp, []byte(b.String()), 0644); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\treturn os.Rename(tmp, filePath)\n}\n\n// All returns the live chat list.\nfunc All() []*Chat {\n\treturn Instance\n}\n\n// FindByID returns the chat with the given session id, or nil.\nfunc FindByID(sessionID string) *Chat {\n\tfor _, c := range Instance {\n\t\tif c.SessionID == sessionID {\n\t\t\treturn c\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// Add records a new chat (name + session id) and persists. If the session id\n// is already known it is a no-op.\nfunc Add(name, sessionID string) error {\n\tif FindByID(sessionID) != nil {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tInstance = append(Instance, &Chat{Name: name, SessionID: sessionID})\n\treturn save()\n}\n\n// Delete removes the chat with the given session id and persists.\nfunc Delete(sessionID string) error {\n\tfor i, c := range Instance {\n\t\tif c.SessionID == sessionID {\n\t\t\tInstance = append(Instance[:i], Instance[i+1:]...)\n\t\t\treturn save()\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// Rename changes a chat's fallback name and persists.\nfunc Rename(sessionID, newName string) error {\n\tnewName = strings.TrimSpace(newName)\n\tif newName == \"\" {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"name cannot be empty\")\n\t}\n\tc := FindByID(sessionID)\n\tif c == nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"no chat with id %q\", sessionID)\n\t}\n\tc.Name = newName\n\treturn save()\n}\n",
                "path": "/Users/egriham/repos/misc/taco/chats/chats.go"
              }
            }

                    "content": "// Package chats persists the list of chat sessions taco knows about, so they\n// can be resumed later. Each entry pairs a fallback name with a provider\n// session id; the live display title is resolved from the provider at render\n// time (see the ui package).\npackage chats\n\nimport (\n\t\"bufio\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"strings\"\n)\n\n// Chat is a saved chat session.\ntype Chat struct {\n\t// Name is a persisted fallback label (used when the provider has no live\n\t// title yet).\n\tName string\n\t// SessionID identifies the chat in the provider (e.g. kiro session id).\n\tSessionID string\n\t// Session is the tmux session handle while the chat is running, or nil.\n\tSession *string\n}\n\n// Instance is the global list of saved chats.\nvar Instance []*Chat\n\nvar filePath string\n\n// Init loads chats from ~/.taco/chats, creating the directory if needed.\nfunc Init() error {\n\thome, err := os.UserHomeDir()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tfilePath = filepath.Join(home, \".taco\", \"chats\")\n\n\tif err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(filePath), 0755); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tchats, err := load()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tInstance = chats\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc load() ([]*Chat, error) {\n\tlist := make([]*Chat, 0)\n\n\tf, err := os.Open(filePath)\n\tif os.IsNotExist(err) {\n\t\treturn list, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tdefer f.Close()\n\n\tscanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)\n\tfor scanner.Scan() {\n\t\tline := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())\n\t\tif line == \"\" {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Format: name#sessionID.\n\t\tname, id, found := strings.Cut(line, \"#\")\n\t\tif !found {\n\t\t\t// No '#': treat the whole line as the session id.\n\t\t\tid = name\n\t\t}\n\t\tlist = append(list, &Chat{Name: name, SessionID: id})\n\t}\n\treturn list, scanner.Err()\n}\n\nfunc save() error {\n\tvar b strings.Builder\n\n\tsorted := make([]*Chat, len(Instance))\n\tcopy(sorted, Instance)\n\tsort.Slice(sorted, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\treturn sorted[i].Name < sorted[j].Name\n\t})\n\n\tfor _, c := range sorted {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(&b, \"%s#%s\\n\", c.Name, c.SessionID)\n\t}\n\n\ttmp := filePath + \".tmp\"\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(tmp, []byte(b.String()), 0644); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\treturn os.Rename(tmp, filePath)\n}\n\n// All returns the live chat list.\nfunc All() []*Chat {\n\treturn Instance\n}\n\n// FindByID returns the chat with the given session id, or nil.\nfunc FindByID(sessionID string) *Chat {\n\tfor _, c := range Instance {\n\t\tif c.SessionID == sessionID {\n\t\t\treturn c\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// Add records a new chat (name + session id) and persists. If the session id\n// is already known it is a no-op.\nfunc Add(name, sessionID string) error {\n\tif FindByID(sessionID) != nil {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tInstance = append(Instance, &Chat{Name: name, SessionID: sessionID})\n\treturn save()\n}\n\n// Delete removes the chat with the given session id and persists.\nfunc Delete(sessionID string) error {\n\tfor i, c := range Instance {\n\t\tif c.SessionID == sessionID {\n\t\t\tInstance = append(Instance[:i], Instance[i+1:]...)\n\t\t\treturn save()\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// Rename changes a chat's fallback name and persists.\nfunc Rename(sessionID, newName string) error {\n\tnewName = strings.TrimSpace(newName)\n\tif newName == \"\" {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"name cannot be empty\")\n\t}\n\tc := FindByID(sessionID)\n\tif c == nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"no chat with id %q\", sessionID)\n\t}\n\tc.Name = newName\n\treturn save()\n}\n"
                  }
                }
              }
            },
            "result": {

                  }

            "data": "Now the Chats-tab UI. I'll create `chats_tab.go` with the list rendering, the new-chat wizard (agent picker → directory browser), and resume logic. The provider needs to be accessible in the ui package — I'll store one on the model. Let me build the chats tab file:"

                "command": "create",
                "content": "package ui\n\nimport (\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\n\ttea \"charm.land/bubbletea/v2\"\n\t\"charm.land/lipgloss/v2\"\n\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/chats\"\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/provider\"\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/repos\"\n)\n\n// chatPhase is the current step of the new-chat wizard.\ntype chatPhase int\n\nconst (\n\tchatPickAgent chatPhase = iota\n\tchatBrowseDir\n\tchatRunning // launched; waiting for the session to be captured on return\n)\n\n// chatWizard holds the state of the new-chat flow.\ntype chatWizard struct {\n\tphase chatPhase\n\n\t// Agent pick phase.\n\tagents      []string\n\tagentCursor int\n\n\t// Directory browse phase (reuses the same idea as the add wizard).\n\tdir     string\n\tentries []string\n\tcursor  int\n\n\t// Chosen values.\n\tagent string\n\n\t// Snapshot of session ids taken before launch, to detect the new one.\n\tbefore map[string]bool\n\n\terr string\n}\n\n// chatsList state on the Chats tab.\n// (cursor/scroll live on the model alongside the repos ones.)\n\n// openChatWizard begins the new-chat flow at the agent picker.\nfunc (m *model) openChatWizard() tea.Cmd {\n\tagents, err := m.provider.Agents()\n\tm.chatting = true\n\tm.chat = chatWizard{phase: chatPickAgent, agents: agents}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tm.chat.err = err.Error()\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (m *model) closeChatWizard() {\n\tm.chatting = false\n\tm.chat = chatWizard{}\n}\n\nfunc (a *chatWizard) loadDir(dir string) {\n\tdirs, err := repos.ListDirs(dir)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\ta.err = err.Error()\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\ta.err = \"\"\n\ta.dir = dir\n\tentries := make([]string, 0, len(dirs)+1)\n\tif filepath.Dir(dir) != dir {\n\t\tentries = append(entries, \"..\")\n\t}\n\tentries = append(entries, dirs...)\n\ta.entries = entries\n\ta.cursor = 0\n}\n\n// updateChatWizard handles a key while the new-chat wizard is open.\nfunc (m *model) updateChatWizard(key string) tea.Cmd {\n\tswitch m.chat.phase {\n\tcase chatPickAgent:\n\t\treturn m.updateChatAgent(key)\n\tcase chatBrowseDir:\n\t\treturn m.updateChatBrowse(key)\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (m *model) updateChatAgent(key string) tea.Cmd {\n\tc := &m.chat\n\tswitch key {\n\tcase \"esc\":\n\t\tm.closeChatWizard()\n\tcase \"up\":\n\t\tif c.agentCursor > 0 {\n\t\t\tc.agentCursor--\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"down\":\n\t\tif c.agentCursor < len(c.agents)-1 {\n\t\t\tc.agentCursor++\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"enter\":\n\t\tif len(c.agents) > 0 {\n\t\t\tc.agent = c.agents[c.agentCursor]\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Move to the directory browser, starting at $HOME.\n\t\thome, err := os.UserHomeDir()\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\thome = \"/\"\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.phase = chatBrowseDir\n\t\tc.loadDir(home)\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (m *model) updateChatBrowse(key string) tea.Cmd {\n\tc := &m.chat\n\tswitch key {\n\tcase \"esc\":\n\t\tm.closeChatWizard()\n\tcase \"up\":\n\t\tif c.cursor > 0 {\n\t\t\tc.cursor--\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"down\":\n\t\tif c.cursor < len(c.entries)-1 {\n\t\t\tc.cursor++\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"enter\", \"right\":\n\t\tif len(c.entries) == 0 {\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tname := c.entries[c.cursor]\n\t\tif name == \"..\" {\n\t\t\tc.loadDir(filepath.Dir(c.dir))\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.loadDir(filepath.Join(c.dir, name))\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"left\":\n\t\tc.loadDir(filepath.Dir(c.dir))\n\tcase \"ctrl+s\":\n\t\t// Start the chat in the current directory.\n\t\treturn m.startChat(c.dir)\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// startChat snapshots existing sessions, then launches the provider's start\n// command in the chosen directory via tea.ExecProcess.\nfunc (m *model) startChat(dir string) tea.Cmd {\n\tbefore, _ := m.provider.SessionSnapshot()\n\tm.chat.before = before\n\tm.chat.phase = chatRunning\n\n\tcmd := m.provider.StartCommand(dir, m.chat.agent)\n\treturn tea.ExecProcess(cmd, func(err error) tea.Msg {\n\t\treturn chatFinishedMsg{dir: dir, err: err}\n\t})\n}\n\n// onChatFinished captures the newly created session (if any) after the chat\n// tmux session is detached.\nfunc (m *model) onChatFinished(msg chatFinishedMsg) {\n\tbefore := m.chat.before\n\tm.closeChatWizard()\n\tif msg.err != nil {\n\t\tm.lastErr = msg.err\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tid, ok := m.provider.DetectNewSession(before, msg.dir)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn // no new session detected; nothing to save\n\t}\n\t// Fallback name: live title if present, else the directory base name.\n\tname := m.provider.SessionTitle(id)\n\tif name == \"\" {\n\t\tname = filepath.Base(msg.dir)\n\t}\n\t_ = chats.Add(name, id)\n}\n\n// resumeSelectedChat resumes the chat under the cursor.\nfunc (m *model) resumeSelectedChat() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {\n\tlist := chats.All()\n\tif len(list) == 0 || m.chatCursor < 0 || m.chatCursor >= len(list) {\n\t\treturn m, nil\n\t}\n\tc := list[m.chatCursor]\n\tcmd := m.provider.ResumeCommand(c.SessionID)\n\treturn m, tea.ExecProcess(cmd, func(err error) tea.Msg {\n\t\treturn chatFinishedMsg{dir: m.provider.SessionCWD(c.SessionID), err: err, resume: true}\n\t})\n}\n\n// chatDisplayName resolves the label for a chat: live provider title preferred,\n// falling back to the persisted name.\nfunc (m model) chatDisplayName(c *chats.Chat) string {\n\tif title := m.provider.SessionTitle(c.SessionID); title != \"\" {\n\t\treturn title\n\t}\n\tif c.Name != \"\" {\n\t\treturn c.Name\n\t}\n\treturn \"untitled\"\n}\n\nfunc (m *model) moveChatCursor(delta int) {\n\tcount := len(chats.All())\n\tnext := m.chatCursor + delta\n\tif next >= 0 && next < count {\n\t\tm.chatCursor = next\n\t}\n}\n\n// --- rendering ---\n\nfunc (m model) renderChatsTab(visibleRows int) string {\n\tif m.chatting {\n\t\treturn m.renderChatWizard(visibleRows)\n\t}\n\n\tlist := chats.All()\n\tif len(list) == 0 {\n\t\treturn muted(\"No chats yet. Press space to start one.\")\n\t}\n\n\tif visibleRows < 1 {\n\t\tvisibleRows = 1\n\t}\n\tstart, end := windowBounds(m.chatCursor, len(list), visibleRows)\n\tlines := make([]string, 0, end-start)\n\tfor i := start; i < end; i++ {\n\t\tlines = append(lines, Row(m.chatDisplayName(list[i]), i == m.chatCursor))\n\t}\n\treturn lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left, lines...)\n}\n\nfunc (m model) renderChatWizard(visibleRows int) string {\n\tswitch m.chat.phase {\n\tcase chatPickAgent:\n\t\treturn m.renderChatAgentPick(visibleRows)\n\tcase chatBrowseDir:\n\t\treturn m.renderChatBrowse(visibleRows)\n\tcase chatRunning:\n\t\treturn dialogTitleStyle.Render(\"Starting chat …\")\n\t}\n\treturn \"\"\n}\n\nfunc (m model) renderChatAgentPick(visibleRows int) string {\n\ttitle := dialogTitleStyle.Render(\"New chat — choose agent\")\n\tif len(m.chat.agents) == 0 {\n\t\treturn lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left, title, \"\", muted(\"No agents found.\"), \"\", Help(\"esc cancel\"))\n\t}\n\tif visibleRows < 1 {\n\t\tvisibleRows = 1\n\t}\n\tstart, end := windowBounds(m.chat.agentCursor, len(m.chat.agents), visibleRows)\n\tlines := make([]string, 0, end-start)\n\tfor i := start; i < end; i++ {\n\t\tlines = append(lines, Row(m.chat.agents[i], i == m.chat.agentCursor))\n\t}\n\tlist := lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left, lines...)\n\thint := Help(\"↑/↓ move · enter select · esc cancel\")\n\treturn lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left, title, \"\", list, \"\", hint)\n}\n\nfunc (m model) renderChatBrowse(visibleRows int) string {\n\ttitle := dialogTitleStyle.Render(\"New chat — pick directory\")\n\tpath := muted(m.chat.dir)\n\tif visibleRows < 1 {\n\t\tvisibleRows = 1\n\t}\n\tstart, end := windowBounds(m.chat.cursor, len(m.chat.entries), visibleRows)\n\tlines := make([]string, 0, end-start)\n\tfor i := start; i < end; i++ {\n\t\tname := m.chat.entries[i]\n\t\tlabel := \"> \" + name\n\t\tif name == \"..\" {\n\t\t\tlabel = \"^ ..\"\n\t\t}\n\t\tlines = append(lines, Row(label, i == m.chat.cursor))\n\t}\n\tlist := lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left, lines...)\n\thint := Help(\"↑/↓ move · enter/→ open · ← up · ctrl+s start here · esc cancel\")\n\tparts := []string{title, path, \"\", list, \"\", hint}\n\tif m.chat.err != \"\" {\n\t\tparts = append(parts, dialogErrStyle.Render(m.chat.err))\n\t}\n\treturn lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left, parts...)\n}\n\nvar _ provider.Provider // keep import if unused paths change\n",

i < end; i++ {\n\t\tname := m.chat.entries[i]\n\t\tlabel := \"> \" + name\n\t\tif name == \"..\" {\n\t\t\tlabel = \"^ ..\"\n\t\t}\n\t\tlines = append(lines, Row(label, i == m.chat.cursor))\n\t}\n\tlist := lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left, lines...)\n\thint := Help(\"↑/↓ move · enter/→ open · ← up · ctrl+s start here · esc cancel\")\n\tparts := []string{title, path, \"\", list, \"\", hint}\n\tif m.chat.err != \"\" {\n\t\tparts = append(parts, dialogErrStyle.Render(m.chat.err))\n\t}\n\treturn lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left, parts...)\n}\n\nvar _ provider.Provider // keep import if unused paths change\n"

                {
                  "kind": "text",
                  "data": "\t\t}\n\n\tcase sessionFinishedMsg:\n\t\t// tmux exited (user detached or session ended); bubbletea resumed.\n\t\t// The launched repo has moved to the top, so follow it with the cursor.\n\t\tm.lastErr = msg.err\n\t\tif m.launchedAlias != \"\" {\n\t\t\tordered := orderedRepos(m.query)\n\t\t\tfor i, repo := range ordered {\n\t\t\t\tif repo.Alias == m.launchedAlias {\n\t\t\t\t\tm.repoCursor = i\n\t\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tm.clampScroll(len(ordered))\n\t\t\tm.launchedAlias = \"\"\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase scanDoneMsg:\n\t\tm.onScanDone(msg)\n\n\tcase tea.KeyPressMsg:\n\t\tkey := msg.String()\n\n\t\t// Settings is a global modal: it opens from any tab and consumes keys.\n\t\tif m.settingsOpen {\n\t\t\tm.updateSettings(key)\n\t\t\treturn m, nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// When the rename dialog is open it is modal: it consumes all keys.\n\t\tif m.renaming {\n\t\t\tm.updateRenameDialog(key)\n\t\t\treturn m, nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// When the add wizard is open it is modal too (and may run a scan Cmd).\n\t\tif m.adding {\n\t\t\treturn m, m.updateAddDialog(key)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// When the delete confirmation is open it is modal.\n\t\tif m.deleting {\n\t\t\tm.updateDeleteDialog(key)\n\t\t\treturn m, nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tswitch key {\n\n\t\t// Quit.\n\t\tcase \"ctrl+c\", \"ctrl+q\":\n\t\t\treturn m, tea.Quit\n\n\t\t// Open global settings.\n\t\tcase \"ctrl+p\":"
                }

          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Wait — `onChatFinished` closes the wizard, but the resume case doesn't go through the wizard. Let me make `onChatFinished` handle the resume case (no wizard open) gracefully — it already checks `m.chat.before` which would be nil on resume, and `closeChatWizard` is harmless. But `DetectNewSession` on resume would find nothing new (correct — resuming doesn't create a session). It's fine. \n\nNow the Chats-tab key routing. When the chat wizard is open, it's modal. Otherwise, on the Chats tab, space/enter/up/down have chat meanings. I'll add: a modal check for `m.chatting`, and handle chat-tab keys. Let me add the modal check near the others and tab-specific handling. Insert the chatting modal check:"
          },
          {
            "kind": "toolUse",
            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "toolu_bdrk_016GLMB1v8NmRTSQ2a6AQGmb",
              "name": "write",
              "input": {
                "__tool_use_purpose": "Route keys to the chat wizard when open (modal).",
                "command": "strReplace",
                "newStr": "\t\t// When the delete confirmation is open it is modal.\n\t\tif m.deleting {\n\t\t\tm.updateDeleteDialog(key)\n\t\t\treturn m, nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// When the new-chat wizard is open it is modal (may run an Exec Cmd).\n\t\tif m.chatting {\n\t\t\treturn m, m.updateChatWizard(key)\n\t\t}",

    {

      "kind": "ToolResults",
      "data": {
        "message_id": "1cc4e111-6188-43e8-b04d-59eacd1a63c7",

            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "toolu_bdrk_014BBwu2XKmfn4wusyGTa3FG",
              "content": [
                {
                  "kind": "text",
                  "data": "\n\t\t// Open the add-repos wizard.\n\t\tcase \"ctrl+n\":\n\t\t\tm.openAddDialog()\n\n\t\t// Open the delete confirmation for the selected repo.\n\t\tcase \"ctrl+d\":\n\t\t\tm.openDeleteDialog()\n\n\t\t// Switch tabs (Tab / Shift+Tab only, so ←/→ are free for in-tab use).\n\t\tcase \"shift+tab\":\n\t\t\tm.activeTab = m.prevTab()\n\t\tcase \"tab\":\n\t\t\tm.activeTab = m.nextTab()\n\n\t\t// Navigate within the active tab.\n\t\tcase \"up\":\n\t\t\tm.moveCursor(-1)\n\t\t\treturn m, m.ensureGitInfo()\n\t\tcase \"down\":\n\t\t\tm.moveCursor(1)\n\t\t\treturn m, m.ensureGitInfo()\n\n\t\t// Launch / attach the selected repo's tmux session.\n\t\tcase \"enter\":\n\t\t\treturn m.launchSelectedRepo()\n\n\t\t// Clear the search query.\n\t\tcase \"esc\", \"alt+backspace\":\n\t\t\tm.setQuery(\"\")\n\t\t\treturn m, m.ensureGitInfo()\n\n\t\t// Delete the last search character.\n\t\tcase \"backspace\":\n\t\t\tif m.query != \"\" {\n\t\t\t\tm.setQuery(m.query[:len(m.query)-1])\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn m, m.ensureGitInfo()\n\n\t\t// Any single printable character is typed into the search box."
                }
              ],
              "status": "success"
            }
          }
        ],

            "kind": "text",
            "data": "I'll make `up`/`down`/`enter` and add `space` tab-aware. On the Chats tab: up/down move the chat cursor, enter resumes, space opens the new-chat wizard. On the Repos tab: current behavior. Let me update:"

            "kind": "toolUse",
            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "toolu_bdrk_01V6GoKYaQNQ39pecXwMVuG9",
              "name": "write",
              "input": {
                "__tool_use_purpose": "Make navigation, enter, and space tab-aware so the Chats tab resumes/starts chats.",
                "command": "strReplace",
                "newStr": "\t\t// Navigate within the active tab.\n\t\tcase \"up\":\n\t\t\tif m.activeTab == TabChats {\n\t\t\t\tm.moveChatCursor(-1)\n\t\t\t\treturn m, nil\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tm.moveCursor(-1)\n\t\t\treturn m, m.ensureGitInfo()\n\t\tcase \"down\":\n\t\t\tif m.activeTab == TabChats {\n\t\t\t\tm.moveChatCursor(1)\n\t\t\t\treturn m, nil\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tm.moveCursor(1)\n\t\t\treturn m, m.ensureGitInfo()\n\n\t\t// Enter: resume a chat on the Chats tab, else launch a repo session.\n\t\tcase \"enter\":\n\t\t\tif m.activeTab == TabChats {\n\t\t\t\treturn m.resumeSelectedChat()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn m.launchSelectedRepo()\n\n\t\t// Space: start a new chat on the Chats tab.\n\t\tcase \" \", \"space\":\n\t\t\tif m.activeTab == TabChats {\n\t\t\t\treturn m, m.openChatWizard()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// On other tabs, space falls through to search input below.\n\t\t\tm.setQuery(m.query + \" \")\n\t\t\treturn m, m.ensureGitInfo()",
                "oldStr": "\t\t// Navigate within the active tab.\n\t\tcase \"up\":\n\t\t\tm.moveCursor(-1)\n\t\t\treturn m, m.ensureGitInfo()\n\t\tcase \"down\":\n\t\t\tm.moveCursor(1)\n\t\t\treturn m, m.ensureGitInfo()\n\n\t\t// Launch / attach the selected repo's tmux session.\n\t\tcase \"enter\":\n\t\t\treturn m.launchSelectedRepo()",
                "path": "/Users/egriham/repos/misc/taco/ui/ui.go"

            "data": "Builds, vets, gofmt-clean. Now let me verify the wizard state machine and session-capture logic with a test (simulating agent pick → dir browse → start → capture), using the real provider against temp session files."
          },
          {
            "kind": "toolUse",

              "toolUseId": "toolu_bdrk_01BZXow2QistvYwWNC1aDZJJ",
              "name": "shell",
              "input": {
                "__tool_use_purpose": "Test the chat wizard flow: agent pick advances to browse; onChatFinished captures a new session and records it.",
                "command": "cat > ui/zz_chat_test.go <<'EOF'\npackage ui\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/chats\"\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/provider\"\n)\n\nfunc writeSession(t *testing.T, dir, id, cwd, title, reason string) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tm := map[string]any{\n\t\t\"session_id\": id, \"cwd\": cwd, \"title\": title,\n\t\t\"session_created_reason\": reason, \"updated_at\": \"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z\",\n\t}\n\tb, _ := json.Marshal(m)\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, id+\".json\"), b, 0644); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestChatWizardCaptureNewSession(t *testing.T) {\n\thome := t.TempDir()\n\tos.Setenv(\"HOME\", home)\n\tsessDir := filepath.Join(home, \".kiro\", \"sessions\", \"cli\")\n\tos.MkdirAll(sessDir, 0755)\n\tos.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(home, \".kiro\", \"agents\"), 0755)\n\tos.WriteFile(filepath.Join(home, \".kiro\", \"agents\", \"worker.json\"), []byte(\"{}\"), 0644)\n\n\tif err := chats.Init(); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }\n\n\tm := model{activeTab: TabChats, provider: provider.NewKiro()}\n\n\t// Pre-existing session (should be ignored by detection).\n\twriteSession(t, sessDir, \"old-id\", \"/work\", \"old\", \"\")\n\n\t// Open wizard -> agent pick.\n\tm.openChatWizard()\n\tif m.chat.phase != chatPickAgent { t.Fatalf(\"expected agent pick\") }\n\t// Select agent -> advances to browse.\n\tm.updateChatWizard(\"enter\")\n\tif m.chat.phase != chatBrowseDir { t.Fatalf(\"expected browse phase, got %v\", m.chat.phase) }\n\tif m.chat.agent != \"worker\" { t.Fatalf(\"agent = %q\", m.chat.agent) }\n\n\t// Simulate start: snapshot before, then a new session appears while \"in tmux\".\n\tbefore, _ := m.provider.SessionSnapshot()\n\tm.chat.before = before\n\tdir := \"/work\"\n\t// kiro creates a subagent AND a main session in dir; main should win.\n\twriteSession(t, sessDir, \"sub-id\", dir, \"\", \"subagent\")\n\twriteSession(t, sessDir, \"new-main\", dir, \"My Chat\", \"\")\n\n\tm.onChatFinished(chatFinishedMsg{dir: dir})\n\n\t// The main (non-subagent) session should be captured, named by its title.\n\tc := chats.FindByID(\"new-main\")\n\tif c == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"new-main not recorded; chats=%+v\", chats.All())\n\t}\n\tif c.Name != \"My Chat\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected title 'My Chat', got %q\", c.Name)\n\t}\n\tif chats.FindByID(\"sub-id\") != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"subagent session should not be recorded\")\n\t}\n\tif chats.FindByID(\"old-id\") != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"pre-existing session should not be recorded\")\n\t}\n\t// Display name resolves to live title.\n\tif got := m.chatDisplayName(c); got != \"My Chat\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"display name = %q\", got)\n\t}\n}\nEOF\ngo test ./ui/ -run TestChatWizardCaptureNewSession -v 2>&1 | tail -12\nrm -f ui/zz_chat_test.go",
                "working_dir": "/Users/egriham/repos/misc/taco"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }

          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Everything builds, vets, and is gofmt-clean across the whole module.\n\nHere's the Chats feature as built, with your requested provider abstraction:\n\n**Provider abstraction (interface + impl, no config file):**\n- `provider.Provider` — the contract (start, resume, sessions dir, list agents, snapshot/detect-new-session, live title/cwd).\n- `kiroProvider` — implements it with your real commands: new chat = tmux session running `kiro-cli --agent <agent>`; resume = tmux session running `kiro-cli chat --resume-id <id>`. Agents come from `~/.kiro/agents/*.json`; sessions from `~/.kiro/sessions/cli`. Adding another provider later = one new struct.\n\n**Chats store (`~/.taco/chats`):** persisted as `name#sessionID`; identity is the session id, display name is the **live title** read from the session file (Option B), falling back to the stored name.\n\n**Chats tab:**\n- Lists saved chats (searchable/scrolling), each labeled by its live title.\n- **Space** → new-chat wizard: **agent picker** → **directory browser** (starts at `$HOME`, `Ctrl+S` to start here) → launches kiro in tmux via `tea.ExecProcess`.\n- On return, taco **diffs the sessions dir** to find the newly-created session, correctly preferring the main session over subagents, reads its title, and records it.\n- **Enter** on an existing chat → resumes it.\n- Chat tmux sessions are separate (`taco-chat-*`) and persist across taco exits, so you can resume.\n\n**Verified:** provider agent/session reading against your real `~/.kiro`, chats CRUD + persistence, and the full wizard→capture flow (including subagent/pre-existing filtering and live-title naming).\n\n**Needs a real TTY to confirm** (I can't drive interactive tmux/kiro from here): actually starting a kiro chat, detaching, and seeing it appear in the list; and resuming one. Please run `go run .`, go to the Chats tab (`Tab`), press Space, pick an agent, browse to a dir, `Ctrl+S`, chat, then detach — and confirm it shows up and resumes with Enter.\n\nOne thing I should flag honestly: the new-chat directory browser uses plain ASCII markers (`>`/`^`) rather than the emoji ones in the add-repos wizard, and the Chats list doesn't have the fixed-width/centering polish the repos list got. If you want the Chats tab to match the repos tab's visual treatment (info panel, alignment, etc.), that's a follow-up worth doing once you've confirmed the core flow works."
          }
        ]
      }
    },

          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "A table with Name, Agent, and Directory columns. Two of those columns need data the chats store doesn't currently keep:\n\n- **Name** — have it (live title / fallback).\n- **Directory** — derivable from the provider (`SessionCWD(sessionID)` reads `cwd` from the session file). ✓ no storage needed.\n- **Agent** — this is the gap. The kiro session JSON has `agent_name`, but in the sample it was `null` (kiro may not always record it). And taco *does* know the agent at creation time (you pick it in the wizard). So the reliable source is to **persist the agent** in the chats file alongside the session id.\n\nThat means extending the chats format. Let me confirm the approach before building: I'll change the store from `name#sessionID` to `name#sessionID#agent` (backward-compatible: a line with no third field has an empty agent). The wizard already knows the chosen agent, so it'll pass it through when recording. For the directory column I'll read it live from the provider (no storage).\n\nLet me first check whether the session JSON's `agent_name` is reliably populated, so I know whether to prefer it or the stored value:"
          },
          {
            "kind": "toolUse",
            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "toolu_bdrk_01PbPnwHwiQW24SFj1FyfWbQ",
              "name": "shell",
              "input": {
                "__tool_use_purpose": "Check whether kiro session files reliably record agent_name, to decide agent data source.",
                "command": "c=0; withagent=0; for f in $(ls -t ~/.kiro/sessions/cli/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -40); do c=$((c+1)); a=$(grep -o '\"agent_name\"[^,]*' \"$f\" | head -1); echo \"$a\"; case \"$a\" in *null*) ;; *) withagent=$((withagent+1));; esac; done | sort | uniq -c | head; echo \"checked=$c with_non_null_agent=$withagent\""
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    },

            "kind": "toolUse",

              "input": {
                "__tool_use_purpose": "Render the chats list as an aligned table with Name/Agent/Directory columns and a header.",
                "command": "strReplace",
                "newStr": "func (m model) renderChatsTab(visibleRows int) string {\n\tif m.chatting {\n\t\treturn m.renderChatWizard(visibleRows)\n\t}\n\n\tlist := chats.All()\n\tif len(list) == 0 {\n\t\treturn muted(\"No chats yet. Press space to start one.\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Build cells and compute column widths from ALL rows so the table does\n\t// not resize while scrolling.\n\tnames := make([]string, len(list))\n\tagents := make([]string, len(list))\n\tdirs := make([]string, len(list))\n\tnameW, agentW := len(\"Name\"), len(\"Agent\")\n\tfor i, c := range list {\n\t\tnames[i] = m.chatDisplayName(c)\n\t\tagents[i] = m.chatAgent(c)\n\t\tdirs[i] = m.chatDir(c)\n\t\tif w := lipgloss.Width(names[i]); w > nameW {\n\t\t\tnameW = w\n\t\t}\n\t\tif w := lipgloss.Width(agents[i]); w > agentW {\n\t\t\tagentW = w\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tpad := func(s string, w int) string {\n\t\tgap := w - lipgloss.Width(s)\n\t\tif gap < 0 {\n\t\t\tgap = 0\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn s + spaces(gap)\n\t}\n\tconst sep = \"  \"\n\n\t// Header (muted) + separator line.\n\theader := chatsHeaderStyle.Render(pad(\"Name\", nameW) + sep + pad(\"Agent\", agentW) + sep + \"Directory\")\n\n\tif visibleRows < 2 {\n\t\tvisibleRows = 2\n\t}\n\trowsAvail := visibleRows - 1 // reserve one line for the header\n\tstart, end := windowBounds(m.chatCursor, len(list), rowsAvail)\n\n\tlines := make([]string, 0, end-start+1)\n\tlines = append(lines, header)\n\tfor i := start; i < end; i++ {\n\t\trow := pad(names[i], nameW) + sep + pad(agents[i], agentW) + sep + dirs[i]\n\t\tlines = append(lines, Row(row, i == m.chatCursor))\n\t}\n\treturn lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left, lines...)\n}\n\n// spaces returns n space characters.\nfunc spaces(n int) string {\n\tif n <= 0 {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\tb := make([]byte, n)\n\tfor i := range b {\n\t\tb[i] = ' '\n\t}\n\treturn string(b)\n}",
                "oldStr": "func (m model) renderChatsTab(visibleRows int) string {\n\tif m.chatting {\n\t\treturn m.renderChatWizard(visibleRows)\n\t}\n\n\tlist := chats.All()\n\tif len(list) == 0 {\n\t\treturn muted(\"No chats yet.             "kind": "text",
            "data": "Verified (tests removed):\n- **Extended format** `name#sessionID#agent` round-trips, and **legacy** two-field lines still parse (agent empty). ✓\n- **Table renders** with `Name`/`Agent`/`Directory` header and the chat rows, showing the agents (`worker`, `analyzer`) via the stored fallback when no live session file exists. ✓\n\nThe Chats tab now shows a table:\n- **Name** — live session title (fallback to stored name / \"untitled\")\n- **Agent** — live `agent_name` from the session file (fallback to the agent you picked at creation, which is now persisted as the third field `name#sessionID#agent`)\n- **Directory** — live `cwd` from the session file\n\nColumn widths are computed from **all** rows so the table doesn't shift while scrolling, there's a header row, and the selected row is highlighted as before. The store format is backward-compatible with any existing two-field entries.\n\nBuilds, vets, gofmt-clean, and the full module test run passes.\n\n**Verification status:** the table rendering, the agent/dir data resolution, and the extended persistence are test-verified. The live end-to-end (start a real chat, see it populate Name/Agent/Directory from the actual session file, resume it) still needs a real TTY — run `go run .`, `Tab` to Chats, and check the table looks right once you have some sessions. Note the columns aren't truncated yet, so a very long directory path could make a row wide; if that bothers you on real data I can add the same left-truncation/fixed-width treatment we used in the add-repos wizard."

          },
          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Sharp question — that exposes a real correctness issue with my fallback logic.\n\nIf you `/agent swap` mid-session, kiro updates `agent_name` in the session file to the new agent. So there are now **two disagreeing sources**: the live `agent_name` (new, correct) and taco's stored agent (the one you picked at creation, now stale).\n\nThe good news: my `chatAgent` helper already **prefers the live value**:\n```go\nfunc (m model) chatAgent(c *chats.Chat) string {\n    if a := m.provider.SessionAgent(c.SessionID); a != \"\" {\n        return a  // live agent_name — reflects the swap\n    }\n    return c.Agent // stored fallback\n}\n```\nSo after a swap, the table shows the **new** agent, because the live `agent_name` is non-empty and wins. That's the correct behavior — same Option-B philosophy as the title. The stored agent is only used when the live one is `null` (which we saw happens ~1 in 8 sessions).\n\nSo the display is already right. But there's a subtler question your example raises: **which agent should a stale stored fallback even represent?** Right now it's frozen at creation time. After a swap, if the live value later becomes `null` for some reason, taco would fall back to the *creation* agent, not the swapped-to one — mildly misleading. Two ways to tighten this:\n\n1. **Leave it** — the live value is almost always present and wins, so this only bites in the rare null case, and even then \"the agent you started with\" is a reasonable guess.\n2. **Refresh the stored agent** to match the live one whenever we read it and they differ, so the fallback stays current. A tiny write, but it means the persisted file self-heals toward the truth.\n\nMy honest take: the display is already correct for your `/agent swap` case, so this is a low-stakes edge. I'd lean toward **leaving it** (option 1) rather than adding write-on-read complexity for a rare null fallback — but if you'd rather the stored value track swaps, option 2 is easy.\n\nWant me to leave it as-is (live value wins, which handles the swap correctly), or add the self-healing refresh?"
          }
        ]
      }

          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Good — glad it works live. Here's exactly how, top to bottom.\n\n**1. The agent lives in the session file, and kiro keeps it current.**\nWhen you `/agent swap`, kiro rewrites its session JSON (`~/.kiro/sessions/cli/<id>.json`), updating the nested field:\n```json\n{ \"session_state\": { \"agent_name\": \"worker\" } }\n```\nSo the file is always the source of truth — kiro maintains it, taco just reads it.\n\n**2. taco reads that field live, on every render.**\nIn the kiro provider, `SessionAgent` reads the file fresh each time it's called:\n```go\nfunc (k *kiroProvider) SessionAgent(sessionID string) string {\n    m, ok := k.readMeta(sessionID)          // reads & parses the JSON file\n    if !ok || m.SessionState.AgentName == nil {\n        return \"\"\n    }\n    return *m.SessionState.AgentName\n}\n```\n`readMeta` does an `os.ReadFile` + `json.Unmarshal` into a struct that mirrors the nested shape:\n```go\ntype sessionMeta struct {\n    ...\n    SessionState struct {\n        AgentName *string `json:\"agent_name\"`\n    } `json:\"session_state\"`\n}\n```\nIt's a `*string` (pointer) specifically so I can tell apart `\"agent_name\": null` (pointer is nil → return \"\") from an actual value.\n\n**3. The table calls it every time it draws.**\n`renderChatsTab` runs on every frame/keypress, and for each row it calls:\n```go\nfunc (m model) chatAgent(c *chats.Chat) string {\n    if a := m.provider.SessionAgent(c.SessionID); a != \"\" {\n        return a          // live value from the file — wins\n    }\n    if c.Agent != \"\" {\n        return c.Agent    // stored fallback (only if live is empty/null)\n    }\n    return \"—\"\n}\n```\n\nSo the chain is: **you swap → kiro rewrites the file → next time taco renders the table, it re-reads the file → the new agent shows up.** There's no caching and no stored state involved in the happy path — the display is always a fresh read of what kiro wrote. That \"read live every render\" is why it just works without taco needing to know a swap happened.\n\nThe stored agent (the `name#sessionID#agent` third field we added) is *only* a fallback for the rare case where the file's `agent_name` is `null`. In your swap case the live value is present, so it wins and the stored one is never consulted.\n\nOne honest caveat about the \"every render\" approach: it does a file read + JSON parse per visible row per frame. For a handful of chats that's completely negligible. If you ever had hundreds of chats visible and it felt sluggish, the fix would be to cache reads and invalidate on file mtime — but we're nowhere near needing that."
          }
        ]
      }

          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Yes — for the *session's own state* (agent, title, working directory), the kiro JSON files are the source of truth, and taco treats them that way: it reads them live on every render rather than storing its own copy. kiro owns those files; taco just reflects them.\n\nBut it's worth being precise, because there are actually **two** sources of truth here with different roles:\n\n**kiro's session JSONs — source of truth for _session state_:**\n- `agent_name`, `title`, `cwd` — whatever kiro currently has. taco reads these fresh, so `/agent swap`, a title change, etc. show up automatically.\n\n**taco's `~/.taco/chats` file — source of truth for _which chats taco tracks_:**\n- This is the list of session IDs taco knows about, i.e. \"these are the chats you asked me to remember and want in the list.\" kiro has hundreds of session files (263 on your machine); taco only shows the ones recorded in `~/.taco/chats`.\n- The stored `name` and `agent` in that file are just **fallbacks** for when kiro's live value is missing (e.g. `title: null` right after creation, or a null `agent_name`).\n\nSo the division is: **taco's file decides _membership_ (what's in your list), kiro's files decide _content_ (what each row displays).** taco never duplicates kiro's state as the authority — it defers to the JSON and only keeps the minimum needed to (a) know the chat exists and (b) have a sensible fallback label.\n\nOne consequence worth knowing: because kiro's file is authoritative for content, if you were to delete a kiro session file, taco's row would fall back to the stored name/agent and show `—` for the directory (live lookup fails). And taco's list entry would still exist until you delete it from taco — the two files can drift, by design, since they answer different questions."
          }
        ]
      }

I need to be careful about the selected-row highlight interacting with the separators — I'll keep the whole row (including separators) passed to `Row`, so the highlight covers the full line consistently."
          },
          {
            "kind": "toolUse",
            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "toolu_bdrk_01Fo34woyz1c7tXdATy7VqMT",
              "name": "write",
              "input": {
                "__tool_use_purpose": "Render the chats table with vertical column separators, an aligned directory column, and a header rule.",
                "command": "strReplace",
                "newStr": "\t// Build cells and compute column widths from ALL rows so the table does\n\t// not resize while scrolling.\n\tnames := make([]string, len(list))\n\tagents := make([]string, len(list))\n\tdirs := make([]string, len(list))\n\tnameW, agentW, dirW := len(\"Name\"), len(\"Agent\"), len(\"Directory\")\n\tfor i, c := range list {\n\t\tnames[i] = m.chatDisplayName(c)\n\t\tagents[i] = m.chatAgent(c)\n\t\tdirs[i] = m.chatDir(c)\n\t\tif w := lipgloss.Width(names[i]); w > nameW {\n\t\t\tnameW = w\n\t\t}\n\t\tif w := lipgloss.Width(agents[i]); w > agentW {\n\t\t\tagentW = w\n\t\t}\n\t\tif w := lipgloss.Width(dirs[i]); w > dirW {\n\t\t\tdirW = w\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tpad := func(s string, w int) string {\n\t\tgap := w - lipgloss.Width(s)\n\t\tif gap < 0 {\n\t\t\tgap = 0\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn s + spaces(gap)\n\t}\n\n\tsep := chatsSepStyle.Render(\" │ \")\n\n\t// Header row + a horizontal rule beneath it.\n\theader := chatsHeaderStyle.Render(pad(\"Name\", nameW)) + sep +\n\t\tchatsHeaderStyle.Render(pad(\"Agent\", agentW)) + sep +\n\t\tchatsHeaderStyle.Render(pad(\"Directory\", dirW))\n\n\t// Rule spans the three columns plus the two separators (3 cells each).\n\truleW := nameW + agentW + dirW + 2*3\n\trule := chatsSepStyle.Render(strings.Repeat(\"─\", ruleW))\n\n\tif visibleRows < 3 {\n\t\tvisibleRows = 3\n\t}\n\trowsAvail := visibleRows - 2 // reserve two lines for header + rule\n\tstart, end := windowBounds(m.chatCursor, len(list), rowsAvail)\n\n\tlines := make([]string, 0, end-start+2)\n\tlines = append(lines, header, rule)\n\tfor i := start; i < end; i++ {\n\t\trow := pad(names[i], nameW) + sep + pad(agents[i], agentW) + sep + pad(dirs[i], dirW)\n\t\tlines = append(lines, Row(row, i == m.chatCursor))\n\t}\n\treturn lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left, lines...)\n}",
                "oldStr": "\t// Build cells and compute column widths from ALL rows so the table does\n\t// not resize while scrolling.\n\tnames := make([]string, len(list))\n\tagents := make([]string, len(list))\n\tdirs := make([]string, len(list))\n\tnameW, agentW := len(\"Name\"), len(\"Agent\")\n\tfor i, c := range list {\n\t\tnames[i] = m.chatDisplayName(c)\n\t\tagents[i] = m.chatAgent(c)\n\t\tdirs[i] = m.chatDir(c)\n\t\tif w := lipgloss.Width(names[i]); w > nameW {\n\t\t\tnameW = w\n\t\t}\n\t\tif w := lipgloss.Width(agents[i]); w > agentW {\n\t\t\tagentW = w\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tpad := func(s string, w int) string {\n\t\tgap := w - lipgloss.Width(s)\n\t\tif gap < 0 {\n\t\t\tgap = 0\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn s + spaces(gap)\n\t}\n\tconst sep = \"  \"\n\n\t// Header (muted) + separator line.\n\theader := chatsHeaderStyle.Render(pad(\"Name\", nameW) + sep + pad(\"Agent\", agentW) + sep + \"Directory\")\n\n\tif visibleRows < 2 {\n\t\tvisibleRows = 2\n\t}\n\trowsAvail := visibleRows - 1 // reserve one line for the header\n\tstart, end := windowBounds(m.chatCursor, len(list), rowsAvail)\n\n\tlines := make([]string, 0, end-start+1)\n\tlines = append(lines, header)\n\tfor i := start; i < end; i++ {\n\t\trow := pad(names[i], nameW) + sep + pad(agents[i], agentW) + sep + dirs[i]\n\t\tlines = append(lines, Row(row, i == m.chatCursor))\n\t}\n\treturn lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left, lines...)\n}",

                "command": "go build ./... 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== vet ===\"; go vet ./... 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== fmt ===\"; gofmt -l .\ncat > ui/zz_table2_test.go <<'EOF'\npackage ui\n\nimport (\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"charm.land/lipgloss/v2\"\n\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/chats\"\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/provider\"\n)\n\nfunc TestChatsTableSeparatorsAndAlignment(t *testing.T) {\n\thome := t.TempDir(); os.Setenv(\"HOME\", home)\n\tos.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(home, \".kiro\", \"sessions\", \"cli\"), 0755)\n\tchats.Init()\n\tchats.Add(\"Alpha\", \"id-a\", \"worker\")\n\tchats.Add(\"A much longer chat name\", \"id-b\", \"analyzer\")\n\tchats.Add(\"C\", \"id-c\", \"insight\")\n\n\tm := model{activeTab: TabChats, provider: provider.NewKiro()}\n\n\t// Width must be identical across scroll positions.\n\tvar widths []int\n\tfor _, cur := range []int{0, 1, 2} {\n\t\tm.chatCursor = cur\n\t\tout := m.renderChatsTab(10)\n\t\tw := 0\n\t\tfor _, l := range strings.Split(out, \"\\n\") {\n\t\t\tif lw := lipgloss.Width(l); lw > w { w = lw }\n\t\t}\n\t\twidths = append(widths, w)\n\t\tif !strings.Contains(out, \"│\") {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"missing column separator\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !strings.Contains(out, \"─\") {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"missing header rule\")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor i := 1; i < len(widths); i++ {\n\t\tif widths[i] != widths[0] {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"table width changed while scrolling: %v\", widths)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\nEOF\ngo test ./ui/ -run TestChatsTableSeparators -v 2>&1 | tail -8\nrm -f ui/zz_table2_test.go",
                "working_dir": "/Users/egriham/repos/misc/taco"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }

          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Verified (test removed): the table now has `│` column separators and a `─` header rule, and its width stays constant across scroll positions (columns don't shift).\n\nThe Chats table now looks like:\n\n```\n  Name                     │ Agent     │ Directory\n  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n› Alpha                    │ worker    │ /Users/egriham/repos/api\n  A much longer chat name  │ analyzer  │ /Users/egriham/work/web\n  C                        │ insight   │ /Users/egriham/tmp\n```\n\nWhat changed:\n- **Vertical separators** (` │ `) between all three columns, styled faint.\n- **Header rule** — a faint `─` line spanning the full table width under the header.\n- **All three columns aligned**, including Directory (previously left ragged), with widths computed from every row so nothing shifts while scrolling.\n- Header and rule indented 2 cells to line up with the row content (the cursor-marker column).\n\nBuilds, vets, gofmt-clean.\n\nTwo things worth noting for a real run (`go run .` → Chats tab):\n- I haven't truncated long values, so a very long directory path will widen the table and could overflow the panel. If your real `cwd` paths are long, tell me and I'll add left-truncation on the Directory column (keeping the tail) so the table fits the box — same technique we used in the add wizard.\n- The separators/header use `Faint` styling rather than theme colors; if you'd like them tinted with the active theme's border color instead, that's a quick change to route through `colorBorder`.\n\nWant me to add directory truncation or theme-tint the separators, or leave it here?"
          }

          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "I can see the reference. Let me note the key visual differences from what I built, so I match it:\n\n- **Outer rounded border** around the whole table (not just a header rule).\n- **No vertical separators** between columns — just clean spacing/alignment.\n- **Header row** in normal text, a blank line under it, then rows (no `─` rule line).\n- **Selected row** is a solid full-width accent (purple) bar spanning the table width, white text.\n- Columns are simply space-aligned; a value that's too long is **truncated with `…`** (e.g. \"Mexico Ci…\").\n- There's padding inside the border.\n\nSo it's essentially: bordered box + aligned columns + full-width highlighted selection + truncation. That maps cleanly onto styles I already have. Let me rebuild `renderChatsTab` to this look.\n\nKey implementation points:\n1. Drop the `│` separators and the `─` rule.\n2. Wrap the whole thing in a rounded border (reuse a panel-like style).\n3. Make the selected row a **full-width** accent bar — so I need to pad each row to the total table width and apply the selected background across the whole line.\n4. Truncate cells that exceed their column width with `…` (right-truncation, like \"Mexico Ci…\").\n\nLet me look at the current function and the selected-row style to reuse:"
          },

                  "kind": "text",
                  "data": "// chatsSepStyle styles column separators and the header rule.\nvar chatsSepStyle = lipgloss.NewStyle().Faint(true)\n\nfunc (m model) renderChatsTab(visibleRows int) string {\n\tif m.chatting {\n\t\treturn m.renderChatWizard(visibleRows)\n\t}\n\n\tlist := chats.All()\n\tif len(list) == 0 {\n\t\treturn muted(\"No chats yet. Press space to start one.\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Build cells and compute column widths from ALL rows so the table does\n\t// not resize while scrolling.\n\tnames := make([]string, len(list))\n\tagents := make([]string, len(list))\n\tdirs := make([]string, len(list))\n\tnameW, agentW, dirW := len(\"Name\"), len(\"Agent\"), len(\"Directory\")\n\tfor i, c := range list {\n\t\tnames[i] = m.chatDisplayName(c)\n\t\tagents[i] = m.chatAgent(c)\n\t\tdirs[i] = m.chatDir(c)\n\t\tif w := lipgloss.Width(names[i]); w > nameW {\n\t\t\tnameW = w\n\t\t}\n\t\tif w := lipgloss.Width(agents[i]); w > agentW {\n\t\t\tagentW = w\n\t\t}\n\t\tif w := lipgloss.Width(dirs[i]); w > dirW {\n\t\t\tdirW = w\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tpad := func(s string, w int) string {\n\t\tgap := w - lipgloss.Width(s)\n\t\tif gap < 0 {\n\t\t\tgap = 0\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn s + spaces(gap)\n\t}\n\n\tsep := chatsSepStyle.Render(\" │ \")\n\n\t// Header row + a horizontal rule beneath it. Indented 2 cells to line up\n\t// with row content (Row prepends a 2-cell cursor column).\n\tconst indent = \"  \"\n\theader := indent + chatsHeaderStyle.Render(pad(\"Name\", nameW)) + sep +\n\t\tchatsHeaderStyle.Render(pad(\"Agent\", agentW)) + sep +\n\t\tchatsHeaderStyle.Render(pad(\"Directory\", dirW))\n\n\t// Rule spans the three columns plus the two separators (3 cells each).\n\truleW := nameW + agentW + dirW + 2*3\n\trule := indent + chatsSepStyle.Render(strings.Repeat(\"─\", ruleW))\n\n\tif visibleRows < 3 {\n\t\tvisibleRows = 3\n\t}\n\trowsAvail := visibleRows - 2 // reserve two lines for header + rule\n\tstart, end := windowBounds(m.chatCursor, len(list), rowsAvail)"
                }
              ],
              "status": "success"
            }
          }

Press space to start one.\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Column layout: fixed max widths keep the table stable and force\n\t// truncation of long values (matching the reference \"Mexico Ci…\").\n\tconst (\n\t\tnameMax  = 24\n\t\tagentMax = 20\n\t\tdirMax   = 40\n\t\tgap      = 3 // spaces between columns\n\t)\n\n\t// Gather cells (truncated) and compute the actual column widths (bounded\n\t// by the max) from ALL rows, so the table doesn't resize while scrolling.\n\tnames := make([]string, len(list))\n\tagents := make([]string, len(list))\n\tdirs := make([]string, len(list))\n\tnameW, agentW, dirW := len(\"Name\"), len(\"Agent\"), len(\"Directory\")\n\tfor i, c := range list {\n\t\tnames[i] = truncateRight(m.chatDisplayName(c), nameMax)\n\t\tagents[i] = truncateRight(m.chatAgent(c), agentMax)\n\t\tdirs[i] = truncateRight(m.chatDir(c), dirMax)\n\t\tnameW = maxi(nameW, lipgloss.Width(names[i]))\n\t\tagentW = maxi(agentW, lipgloss.Width(agents[i]))\n\t\tdirW = maxi(dirW, lipgloss.Width(dirs[i]))\n\t}\n\n\tg := spaces(gap)\n\trowWidth := nameW + agentW + dirW + 2*gap\n\n\tpad := func(s string, w int) string { return s + spaces(w-lipgloss.Width(s)) }\n\trowText := func(n, a, d string) string {\n\t\treturn pad(n, nameW) + g + pad(a, agentW) + g + pad(d, dirW)\n\t}\n\n\t// Header (subtle) + blank line, matching the reference.\n\theader := chatsSepStyle.Render(rowText(\"Name\", \"Agent\", \"Directory\"))\n\n\tif visibleRows < 4 {\n\t\tvisibleRows = 4\n\t}\n\trowsAvail := visibleRows - 3 // header + blank + border padding budget\n\tstart, end := windowBounds(m.chatCursor, len(list), rowsAvail)\n\n\tlines := make([]string, 0, end-start+2)\n\tlines = append(lines, header, \"\")\n\tfor i := start; i < end; i++ {\n\t\tline := rowText(names[i], agents[i], dirs[i])\n\t\tif i == m.chatCursor {\n\t\t\t// Full-width accent bar across the whole row.\n\t\t\tline = chatsSelectedRowStyle.Width(rowWidth).Render(line)\n\t\t}\n\t\tlines = append(lines, line)\n\t}\n\n\ttable := lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left, lines...)\n\treturn chatsTableStyle.BorderForeground(colorBorder).Render(table)\n}\n\n// truncateRight shortens s to at most max display cells, appending \"…\".\nfunc truncateRight(s string, max int) string {\n\tif max <= 0 {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\tif lipgloss.Width(s) <= max {\n\t\treturn s\n\t}\n\tif max == 1 {\n\t\treturn \"…\"\n\t}\n\trunes := []rune(s)\n\tkeep := max - 1\n\tif keep > len(runes) {\n\t\tkeep = len(runes)\n\t}\n\treturn string(runes[:keep]) + \"…\"\n}\n\n// maxi returns the larger of two ints.\nfunc maxi(a, b int) int {\n\tif a > b {\n\t\treturn a\n\t}\n\treturn b\n}\n\n// spaces returns n space characters.\nfunc spaces(n int) string {\n\tif n <= 0 {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\tb := make([]byte, n)\n\tfor i := range b {\n\t\tb[i] = ' '\n\t}\n\treturn string(b)",

                "command": "go build ./... 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== vet ===\"; go vet ./... 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== fmt ===\"; gofmt -l .\ncat > ui/zz_table3_test.go <<'EOF'\npackage ui\n\nimport (\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"charm.land/lipgloss/v2\"\n\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/chats\"\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/provider\"\n)\n\nfunc TestChatsTableStyled(t *testing.T) {\n\thome := t.TempDir(); os.Setenv(\"HOME\", home)\n\tos.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(home, \".kiro\", \"sessions\", \"cli\"), 0755)\n\tchats.Init()\n\tchats.Add(\"Alpha\", \"id-a\", \"worker\")\n\tchats.Add(\"A very very long chat name that should get truncated\", \"id-b\", \"analyzer\")\n\tchats.Add(\"Gamma\", \"id-c\", \"insight\")\n\n\tm := model{activeTab: TabChats, provider: provider.NewKiro()}\n\tApplyThemeByName(\"Default\")\n\n\t// Bordered (rounded corners present).\n\tout := m.renderChatsTab(12)\n\tif !strings.Contains(out, \"╭\") || !strings.Contains(out, \"╯\") {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected rounded border\\n%s\", out)\n\t}\n\t// Long name truncated with ellipsis.\n\tif !strings.Contains(out, \"…\") {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected truncation ellipsis\\n%s\", out)\n\t}\n\t// Header present.\n\tfor _, h := range []string{\"Name\", \"Agent\", \"Directory\"} {\n\t\tif !strings.Contains(out, h) { t.Errorf(\"missing header %q\", h) }\n\t}\n\t// Width stable across scroll.\n\tw0 := 0\n\tfor _, l := range strings.Split(out, \"\\n\") { if x := lipgloss.Width(l); x > w0 { w0 = x } }\n\tm.chatCursor = 2\n\tout2 := m.renderChatsTab(12)\n\tw1 := 0\n\tfor _, l := range strings.Split(out2, \"\\n\") { if x := lipgloss.Width(l); x > w1 { w1 = x } }\n\tif w0 != w1 { t.Fatalf(\"width changed: %d vs %d\", w0, w1) }\n}\nEOF\ngo test ./ui/ -run TestChatsTableStyled -v 2>&1 | tail -8\nrm -f ui/zz_table3_test.go",

            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Verified (test removed): the table now has a **rounded border**, **truncates** long values with `…`, shows the **Name/Agent/Directory** header, and keeps a **stable width** across scroll positions.\n\nThe Chats table now matches the reference style:\n- **Rounded border** around the whole table with internal padding.\n- **Header row** (Name / Agent / Directory) in subtle/faint text, followed by a blank line — no `│` separators or `─` rule.\n- **Columns space-aligned** with fixed max widths; values longer than their column are **truncated with `…`** (like \"Mexico Ci…\").\n- **Selected row** is a **full-width accent bar** (theme accent background, contrasting foreground) spanning the table, matching the purple highlight in the screenshot.\n- The selection bar and border use the **active theme colors** and re-tint when you change themes (wired into `rebuildThemedStyles`).\n\nBuilds, vets, gofmt-clean.\n\n**Verification status:** border, truncation, header, and width-stability are test-verified.                 "command": "strReplace",
                "newStr": "func (m model) renderChatsTab(width, height int) string {\n\t// Inner content rows available after the border (2) + vertical padding (2).\n\tinnerRows := height - 4\n\tif innerRows < 1 {\n\t\tinnerRows = 1\n\t}\n\n\tif m.chatting {\n\t\tbody := m.renderChatWizard(innerRows)\n\t\treturn chatsTableStyle.BorderForeground(colorBorder).\n\t\t\tWidth(width).Height(height).Render(body)\n\t}\n\n\tlist := chats.All()\n\tif len(list) == 0 {\n\t\treturn chatsTableStyle.BorderForeground(colorBorder).\n\t\t\tWidth(width).Height(height).\n\t\t\tRender(muted(\"No chats yet. Press space to start one.\"))\n\t}\n\n\t// Column layout: fixed max widths keep the table stable and force\n\t// truncation of long values (matching the reference \"Mexico Ci…\").\n\tconst (\n\t\tnameMax  = 24\n\t\tagentMax = 20\n\t\tdirMax   = 40\n\t\tgap      = 3 // spaces between columns\n\t)\n\n\t// Gather cells (truncated) and compute the actual column widths (bounded\n\t// by the max) from ALL rows, so the table doesn't resize while scrolling.\n\tnames := make([]string, len(list))\n\tagents := make([]string, len(list))\n\tdirs := make([]string, len(list))\n\tnameW, agentW, dirW := len(\"Name\"), len(\"Agent\"), len(\"Directory\")\n\tfor i, c := range list {\n\t\tnames[i] = truncateRight(m.chatDisplayName(c), nameMax)\n\t\tagents[i] = truncateRight(m.chatAgent(c), agentMax)\n\t\tdirs[i] = truncateRight(m.chatDir(c), dirMax)\n\t\tnameW = maxi(nameW, lipgloss.Width(names[i]))\n\t\tagentW = maxi(agentW, lipgloss.Width(agents[i]))\n\t\tdirW = maxi(dirW, lipgloss.Width(dirs[i]))\n\t}\n\n\tg := spaces(gap)\n\trowWidth := nameW + agentW + dirW + 2*gap\n\n\tpad := func(s string, w int) string { return s + spaces(w-lipgloss.Width(s)) }\n\trowText := func(n, a, d string) string {\n\t\treturn pad(n, nameW) + g + pad(a, agentW) + g + pad(d, dirW)\n\t}\n\n\t// Header (subtle) + blank line, matching the reference.\n\theader := chatsSepStyle.Render(rowText(\"Name\", \"Agent\", \"Directory\"))\n\n\t// Rows that fit after the header + blank line.\n\trowsAvail := innerRows - 2\n\tif rowsAvail < 1 {\n\t\trowsAvail = 1\n\t}\n\tstart, end := windowBounds(m.chatCursor, len(list), rowsAvail)\n\n\tlines := make([]string, 0, end-start+2)\n\tlines = append(lines, header, \"\")\n\tfor i := start; i < end; i++ {\n\t\tline := rowText(names[i], agents[i], dirs[i])\n\t\tif i == m.chatCursor {\n\t\t\t// Full-width accent bar across the whole row.\n\t\t\tline = chatsSelectedRowStyle.Width(rowWidth).Render(line)\n\t\t}\n\t\tlines = append(lines, line)\n\t}\n\n\ttable := lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left, lines...)\n\treturn chatsTableStyle.BorderForeground(colorBorder).\n\t\tWidth(width).Height(height).Render(table)\n}",

i < end; i++ {\n\t\tline := rowText(names[i], agents[i], dirs[i])\n\t\tif i == m.chatCursor {\n\t\t\t// Full-width accent bar across the whole row.\n\t\t\tline = chatsSelectedRowStyle.Width(rowWidth).Render(line)\n\t\t}\n\t\tlines = append(lines, line)\n\t}\n\n\ttable := lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left, lines...)\n\treturn chatsTableStyle.BorderForeground(colorBorder).\n\t\tWidth(width).Height(height).Render(table)\n}",

                    "newStr": "\t// Column layout: fixed max widths keep the table stable and force\n\t// truncation of long values (matching the reference \"Mexico Ci…\").\n\tconst (\n\t\tnameMax  = 24\n\t\tagentMax = 20\n\t\tdirMax   = 40\n\t\tminGap   = 2 // minimum spacing between columns\n\t)\n\n\t// Gather cells (truncated) and compute the actual column widths (bounded\n\t// by the max) from ALL rows, so the table doesn't resize while scrolling.\n\tnames := make([]string, len(list))\n\tagents := make([]string, len(list))\n\tdirs := make([]string, len(list))\n\tnameW, agentW, dirW := len(\"Name\"), len(\"Agent\"), len(\"Directory\")\n\tfor i, c := range list {\n\t\tnames[i] = truncateRight(m.chatDisplayName(c), nameMax)\n\t\tagents[i] = truncateRight(m.chatAgent(c), agentMax)\n\t\tdirs[i] = truncateRight(m.chatDir(c), dirMax)\n\t\tnameW = maxi(nameW, lipgloss.Width(names[i]))\n\t\tagentW = maxi(agentW, lipgloss.Width(agents[i]))\n\t\tdirW = maxi(dirW, lipgloss.Width(dirs[i]))\n\t}\n\n\t// Distribute the leftover horizontal space across the two inter-column\n\t// gaps so the columns spread across the full inner width of the box.\n\tinnerW := width - 4 // border (2) + horizontal padding (2)\n\tgapTotal := innerW - (nameW + agentW + dirW)\n\tgap1, gap2 := minGap, minGap\n\tif gapTotal >= 2*minGap {\n\t\tgap1 = gapTotal / 2\n\t\tgap2 = gapTotal - gap1\n\t}\n\n\trowWidth := nameW + agentW + dirW + gap1 + gap2\n\n\tpad := func(s string, w int) string { return s + spaces(w-lipgloss.Width(s)) }\n\trowText := func(n, a, d string) string {\n\t\treturn pad(n, nameW) + spaces(gap1) + pad(a, agentW) + spaces(gap2) + d\n\t}\n\n\t// Header (subtle) + blank line, matching the reference.\n\theader := chatsSepStyle.Render(rowText(\"Name\", \"Agent\", \"Directory\"))",

          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "One concern: the selected-row bar uses `chatsSelectedRowStyle.Width(rowWidth)`. Now `rowWidth` fills the inner width, so the accent bar spans the full box width — which is exactly the reference look (full-width highlight). Good. But note the last column (Directory) is no longer padded to `dirW` in `rowText` — I dropped the trailing pad since it's the last column. For the selected row, the `.Width(rowWidth)` on the style will pad the whole line to full width anyway, so the bar still spans fully. Let me build and verify the columns now spread to fill:"

            "kind": "toolUse",
            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "toolu_bdrk_01Qbm1EydSPtLBovGYho6zze",

                "command": "go build ./... 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== vet ===\"; go vet ./... 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== fmt ===\"; gofmt -l .\ncat > ui/zz_spread_test.go <<'EOF'\npackage ui\n\nimport (\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"charm.land/lipgloss/v2\"\n\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/chats\"\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/provider\"\n)\n\nfunc TestChatsColumnsSpread(t *testing.T) {\n\thome := t.TempDir(); os.Setenv(\"HOME\", home)\n\tos.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(home, \".kiro\", \"sessions\", \"cli\"), 0755)\n\tchats.Init()\n\tchats.Add(\"Alpha\", \"id-a\", \"worker\")\n\tchats.Add(\"Beta\", \"id-b\", \"analyzer\")\n\n\tm := model{activeTab: TabChats, provider: provider.NewKiro()}\n\tApplyThemeByName(\"Default\")\n\n\tconst W, H = 100, 20\n\tout := m.renderChatsTab(W, H)\n\tlines := strings.Split(out, \"\\n\")\n\n\t// Find the header line and check \"Directory\" ends near the right edge,\n\t// i.e. columns spread rather than pack left.\n\tvar headerLine string\n\tfor _, l := range lines {\n\t\tif strings.Contains(l, \"Directory\") { headerLine = l; break }\n\t}\n\tif headerLine == \"\" { t.Fatal(\"no header line\") }\n\t// The content width should be close to the inner width (W-4), meaning the\n\t// gaps expanded. Strip border chars for a rough content measure.\n\t// Simpler: the visible width of the whole line is W (border fills), and the\n\t// \"Directory\" label should appear well past the middle.\n\tidx := strings.Index(stripANSI(headerLine), \"Directory\")\n\tif idx < (W-4)/2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Directory column not pushed right (idx=%d, W=%d)\", idx, W)\n\t}\n\t_ = lipgloss.Width\n}\n\n// stripANSI removes escape sequences for index math.\nfunc stripANSI(s string) string {\n\tvar b strings.Builder\n\tinEsc := false\n\tfor _, r := range s {\n\t\tif r == 0x1b { inEsc = true; continue }\n\t\tif inEsc {\n\t\t\tif (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') { inEsc = false }\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tb.WriteRune(r)\n\t}\n\treturn b.String()\n}\nEOF\ngo test ./ui/ -run TestChatsColumnsSpread -v 2>&1 | tail -8\nrm -f ui/zz_spread_test.go",

            "data": "Now I see two real problems in the actual output:\n\n1. **The header wrapped onto two lines** (line 2 ends with \"Agent\", line 3 has \"Directory\" alone). The header content exceeded the box width and wrapped, because my `rowText` for the header used the *huge* gaps but the total exceeded `innerW`. Actually the gaps made it too wide.\n\n2. **The columns didn't spread as intended** — \"Name ... Agent\" have a big gap but \"Directory\" wrapped. The gap distribution math is off: with `dir` being the last column and not padded, plus the gaps, the line total overshot the inner width and wrapped.\n\nThe core issue: I distributed *all* leftover space into the two gaps, but the columns' natural widths (bounded by their maxes: 24+20+40=84) plus large gaps exceed a 96-inner-width box → wrap. Wait, 84 + gaps... innerW=96, leftover = 96-84 = 12, split into gap1=6, gap2=6 → total 84+12=96. That fits exactly. But `.Render` with `chatsSelectedRowStyle.Width` and the border's own `.Width(width)` — the border style *also* wraps content that's too wide. The header isn't styled with a width cap, so if it's exactly innerW it's fine... but it wrapped, so it must be 1-2 over.\n\nThe real culprit: the outer `chatsTableStyle.Width(width)` sets total box width, giving content width `width - border - padding`. But I computed `innerW = width - 4`, matching border(2)+padding(2)... except `chatsTableStyle` has `Padding(1, 2)` = **2 horizontal each side = 4 total**, plus border 2 = 6, not 4. So my `innerW` is 2 too big → content overflows by 2 → wraps.\n\nLet me fix `innerW` to account for the real padding (4 horizontal) + border (2) = 6:"

                "command": "strReplace",
                "newStr": "\t// Distribute the leftover horizontal space across the two inter-column\n\t// gaps so the columns spread across the full inner width of the box.\n\t// chatsTableStyle: border (2) + horizontal padding (4) = 6.\n\tinnerW := width - 6\n\tgapTotal := innerW - (nameW + agentW + dirW)\n\tgap1, gap2 := minGap, minGap\n\tif gapTotal >= 2*minGap {\n\t\tgap1 = gapTotal / 2\n\t\tgap2 = gapTotal - gap1\n\t}",

                "command": "go build ./... 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== vet ===\"; go vet ./... 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== fmt ===\"; gofmt -l .\ncat > ui/zz_spread_test.go <<'EOF'\npackage ui\n\nimport (\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"charm.land/lipgloss/v2\"\n\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/chats\"\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/provider\"\n)\n\nfunc stripANSI(s string) string {\n\tvar b strings.Builder\n\tinEsc := false\n\tfor _, r := range s {\n\t\tif r == 0x1b { inEsc = true; continue }\n\t\tif inEsc {\n\t\t\tif (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') { inEsc = false }\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tb.WriteRune(r)\n\t}\n\treturn b.String()\n}\n\nfunc TestChatsColumnsSpread(t *testing.T) {\n\thome := t.TempDir(); os.Setenv(\"HOME\", home)\n\tos.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(home, \".kiro\", \"sessions\", \"cli\"), 0755)\n\tchats.Init(); chats.Add(\"Alpha\", \"id-a\", \"worker\"); chats.Add(\"Beta\", \"id-b\", \"analyzer\")\n\tm := model{activeTab: TabChats, provider: provider.NewKiro()}\n\tApplyThemeByName(\"Default\")\n\n\tconst W, H = 100, 20\n\tout := m.renderChatsTab(W, H)\n\tlines := strings.Split(out, \"\\n\")\n\n\t// No wrapping: exactly H lines.\n\tif len(lines) != H { t.Fatalf(\"expected %d lines, got %d\", H, len(lines)) }\n\n\t// Header: Directory should sit in the last third (columns spread).\n\tvar hdr string\n\tfor _, l := range lines { if strings.Contains(l, \"Directory\") { hdr = stripANSI(l); break } }\n\tidx := strings.Index(hdr, \"Directory\")\n\tinnerW := W - 6\n\tif idx < 2*innerW/3-4 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Directory not in last third: idx=%d innerW=%d\", idx, innerW)\n\t}\n\t_ = lipgloss.Width\n}\nEOF\ngo test ./ui/ -run TestChatsColumnsSpread -v 2>&1 | tail -8\nrm -f ui/zz_spread_test.go",
                "working_dir": "/Users/egriham/repos/misc/taco"
              }
            }
