          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Good catch. The problem is that when a Name is truncated to *exactly* its full column width, there's zero space before the next column starts — so `…` butts right up against the agent name. My `fit` pads to the column width, but if the value fills the entire width there's no gap left.\n\nThe fix: reserve a **minimum gap** inside each column so a value can never consume the full column width — truncate to `colW - gap` and let the padding fill the rest. That guarantees at least that many spaces between columns regardless of how long the value is."
          },
          {
            "kind": "toolUse",
            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "toolu_bdrk_01FsvCL7MKwTTVwwGmb9T1jY",
              "name": "write",
              "input": {
                "__tool_use_purpose": "Reserve a minimum inter-column gap so truncated values never touch the next column.",
                "command": "strReplace",
                "newStr": "\trowWidth := innerW\n\n\t// Minimum spacing kept between columns: truncate values to leave room so a\n\t// long value never butts up against the next column.\n\tconst colGap = 2\n\n\t// fit truncates a value to (w - colGap) then pads it to exactly w cells,\n\t// guaranteeing at least colGap spaces before the next column.\n\tfit := func(s string, w int) string {\n\t\treturn pad2(truncateRight(s, w-colGap), w)\n\t}\n\trowText := func(n, a, d string) string {\n\t\treturn fit(n, nameW) + fit(a, agentW) + fit(d, dirW)\n\t}",
                "oldStr": "\trowWidth := innerW\n\n\t// fit truncates then pads a value to exactly w cells.\n\tfit := func(s string, w int) string { return pad2(truncateRight(s, w), w) }\n\trowText := func(n, a, d string) string {\n\t\treturn fit(n, nameW) + fit(a, agentW) + fit(d, dirW)\n\t}",
                "path": "/Users/egriham/repos/misc/taco/ui/chats_tab.go"
              }
            }
          }
        ]

          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "One more: on the Chats tab, the default key case that types into search also calls `m.ensureGitInfo()` (a repos concern) — harmless on Chats since `selectedRepo()` returns nil and it returns no command. But let me verify the space handling: on the Chats tab, space opens the new-chat wizard, so you can't type a space *into* the chat search. That's a minor limitation — chat names could contain spaces. Given the reference use (\"curl -fSL...\"), spaces in search would be useful. Let me reconsider: on the Chats tab, should space search or open new-chat?\n\nI'll keep space = new-chat (it's the documented action you asked for), but note the tradeoff. Actually, a cleaner resolution: only treat space as new-chat when the query is **empty** (nothing typed yet); once you're typing a search, space adds to the query. Let me check the current space handling:"
          },
          {
            "kind": "toolUse",
            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "toolu_bdrk_01MD4NU5yfMqVvF2PyQwpxWW",
              "name": "read",
              "input": {
                "__tool_use_purpose": "Review the space key handling to allow space in chat search once typing has begun.",

                "command": "go build ./... 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== vet ===\"; go vet ./... 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== fmt ===\"; gofmt -l .\ncat > ui/zz_search_test.go <<'EOF'\npackage ui\n\nimport (\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/chats\"\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/provider\"\n)\n\nfunc TestChatSearchAcrossColumns(t *testing.T) {\n\thome := t.TempDir(); os.Setenv(\"HOME\", home)\n\tos.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(home, \".kiro\", \"sessions\", \"cli\"), 0755)\n\tchats.Init()\n\t// No live session files, so name/agent come from stored fallbacks; dir is \"—\".\n\tchats.Add(\"Deploy pipeline\", \"id-1\", \"worker\")\n\tchats.Add(\"Fix login bug\", \"id-2\", \"analyzer\")\n\tchats.Add(\"Refactor auth\", \"id-3\", \"worker\")\n\n\tm := model{activeTab: TabChats, provider: provider.NewKiro()}\n\n\t// Match by name.\n\tm.query = \"login\"\n\tif got := m.filteredChats(); len(got) != 1 || got[0].SessionID != \"id-2\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"name search failed: %+v\", got)\n\t}\n\t// Match by agent (two workers).\n\tm.query = \"worker\"\n\tif got := m.filteredChats(); len(got) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"agent search failed: got %d\", len(got))\n\t}\n\t// Case-insensitive.\n\tm.query = \"REFACTOR\"\n\tif got := m.filteredChats(); len(got) != 1 || got[0].SessionID != \"id-3\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"case-insensitive search failed: %+v\", got)\n\t}\n\t// No match.\n\tm.query = \"zzz\"\n\tif got := m.filteredChats(); len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected no matches, got %d\", len(got))\n\t}\n\t// Empty query returns all.\n\tm.query = \"\"\n\tif got := m.filteredChats(); len(got) != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"empty query should return all, got %d\", len(got))\n\t}\n}\nEOF\ngo test ./ui/ -run TestChatSearchAcrossColumns -v 2>&1 | tail -6\nrm -f ui/zz_search_test.go",
                "working_dir": "/Users/egriham/repos/misc/taco"
              }
            }
          }

            "data": "Verified (test removed): chat search filters across all three columns —\n- Match by **Name** (`login` → the login bug chat)\n- Match by **Agent** (`worker` → both worker chats)\n- **Case-insensitive** (`REFACTOR` → Refactor auth)\n- No-match returns empty; empty query returns all. ✓\n\n(Directory matching works the same way; the test used no live session files so `dir` was `—`, but the search string includes the resolved directory.)\n\nSummary of what changed on the Chats tab:\n- **Search filters the table** across Name / Agent / Directory (case-insensitive substring), using the same global search box you already type into.\n- **Empty vs no-match** messages: \"No chats yet…\" when there are none, \"No matches.\" when a query filters everything out.\n- **Cursor stays valid** — resets to top on query change, and both navigation and resume use the filtered list so the highlighted row is the one that gets resumed.\n- **Space behavior**: on the Chats tab, space starts a new chat only when the search is empty; once you're typing a query, space becomes part of the search (so you can search titles like `curl -fSL ...` that contain spaces).\n\nBuilds, vets, gofmt-clean.             "kind": "text",
            "data": "Verified (test removed): the footer hint now changes with context —\n- **Repos tab**: `↑/↓ navigate · type to search · ctrl+n add · ctrl+r rename · ctrl+d delete · enter open · …`\n- **Chats tab**: `↑/↓ navigate · type to search · space new chat · enter resume · …`\n- **Modals** (settings / rename / delete / add wizard / chat wizard) each show their own relevant keys, taking priority over the tab hint.\n\nAll end with the common `tab switch tabs · ctrl+p settings · ctrl+c quit`.\n\nBuilds, vets, gofmt-clean.\n\nOne thing to be aware of when you run it: the add/rename/delete/chat modals *also* render a hint line inside the dialog itself (from earlier), so while a modal is open you'll now see a similar hint both in the dialog and in the footer. It's not wrong, just slightly redundant. If that double-hint bugs you, I can either drop the in-dialog hint (letting the footer be the single source) or drop the footer hint while a modal is open. Which do you prefer — or leave both?"

          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Delete chats — same pattern as deleting repos, with a confirmation dialog. Since `Ctrl+D` already deletes repos, I'll make it tab-aware: on the Chats tab it deletes the selected chat.\n\nOne design decision: deleting a chat from taco should remove it from taco's list (`chats.Delete`), but should it also delete the underlying **kiro session file**? I'd say **no** — taco's list is just \"chats I track\" (per our earlier source-of-truth discussion); removing an entry shouldn't destroy kiro's actual session data, which you might resume via kiro directly. So delete = remove from taco's tracking only. I'll make the confirmation wording clear about that (\"Remove from taco?\" not \"Delete session\").\n\nLet me build it. I'll reuse the existing `deleteDialog` infrastructure but make it work for chats too. Simplest approach: a small chat-delete confirmation. Let me look at the existing delete dialog to decide whether to generalize it or add a parallel one."
          },

    {
      "version": "v1",
      "kind": "ToolResults",
      "data": {
        "message_id": "452cf0f1-74b0-45fa-9e69-5723291b3e54",

              "toolUseId": "toolu_bdrk_01XhXMDxCrmrsrD4kBErmHJV",
              "content": [
                {
                  "kind": "text",
                  "data": "package ui\n\nimport (\n\t\"charm.land/lipgloss/v2\"\n\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/commands\"\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/repos\"\n)\n\n// deleteDialog holds the state of the delete-confirmation modal.\ntype deleteDialog struct {\n\talias   string       // repo being deleted\n\tconfirm dialogButton // focused button (buttonSave = Delete, buttonCancel = Cancel)\n\terr     string\n}\n\n// openDeleteDialog opens the confirmation for the selected repo.\nfunc (m *model) openDeleteDialog() {\n\tordered := orderedRepos(m.query)\n\tif m.activeTab != TabRepos || len(ordered) == 0 {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif m.repoCursor >= len(ordered) {\n\t\tm.repoCursor = len(ordered) - 1\n\t}\n\tm.deleting = true\n\tm.del = deleteDialog{\n\t\talias:   ordered[m.repoCursor].Alias,\n\t\tconfirm: buttonCancel, // default to the safe choice\n\t}\n}\n\n// closeDeleteDialog exits delete mode.\nfunc (m *model) closeDeleteDialog() {\n\tm.deleting = false\n\tm.del = deleteDialog{}\n}\n\n// updateDeleteDialog handles a key while the confirmation is open.\nfunc (m *model) updateDeleteDialog(key string) {\n\tswitch key {\n\tcase \"esc\", \"n\":\n\t\tm.closeDeleteDialog()\n\n\tcase \"left\", \"right\", \"tab\", \"shift+tab\":\n\t\tif m.del.confirm == buttonSave {\n\t\t\tm.del.confirm = buttonCancel\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tm.del.confirm = buttonSave\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase \"y\":\n\t\tm.commitDelete()\n\n\tcase \"enter\":\n\t\tif m.del.confirm == buttonCancel {\n\t\t\tm.closeDeleteDialog()\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.commitDelete()\n\t}\n}\n\n// commitDelete terminates any live session for the repo, removes it, and moves\n// the cursor to a valid position.\nfunc (m *model) commitDelete() {\n\talias := m.del.alias\n\tif repo := repos.Find(alias); repo != nil && repo.Session != nil {\n\t\t// Best-effort terminate; ignore error (session may already be gone).\n\t\t_ = commands.TerminateSession(repo.Session.ID).Run()\n\t\trepo.Session = nil\n\t}\n\n\tif err := repos.Delete(alias); err != nil {\n\t\tm.del.err = err.Error()\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tm.closeDeleteDialog()\n\n\t// Keep the cursor within bounds after removal.\n\tcount := len(orderedRepos(m.query))\n\tif m.repoCursor >= count {\n\t\tm.repoCursor = count - 1\n\t}\n\tif m.repoCursor < 0 {\n\t\tm.repoCursor = 0\n\t}\n\tm.clampScroll(count)\n}\n\n// --- rendering ---\n\nvar deleteBoxStyle = lipgloss.NewStyle().\n\tBorder(lipgloss.RoundedBorder()).\n\tBorderForeground(lipgloss.Color(\"196\")). // red border for a destructive action\n\tPadding(1, 2)\n\n// renderDeleteDialog draws the confirmation modal.\nfunc (m model) renderDeleteDialog() string {\n\ttitle := dialogTitleStyle.Render(\"Delete repo\")\n\tquestion := \"Remove \\\"\" + m.del.alias + \"\\\" from taco?\"\n\n\tcancel := buttonStyle.Render(\"Cancel\")\n\tdel := buttonStyle.Render(\"Delete\")\n\tif m.del.confirm == buttonSave {\n\t\tdel = buttonFocusedStyle.Render(\"Delete\")\n\t} else {\n\t\tcancel = buttonFocusedStyle.Render(\"Cancel\")\n\t}\n\tbuttons := lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(lipgloss.Top, cancel, del)\n\n\tparts := []string{title, \"\", question, \"\"}\n\tif m.del.err != \"\" {\n\t\tparts = append(parts, dialogErrStyle.Render(m.del.err), \"\")\n\t}\n\tparts = append(parts, buttons, \"\", Help(\"y delete · n/esc cancel · ←/→ switch · enter confirm\"))\n\n\tbody := lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Center, parts...)\n\treturn deleteBoxStyle.Render(body)\n}"
                }

                    "Text": "package ui\n\nimport (\n\t\"charm.land/lipgloss/v2\"\n\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/commands\"\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/repos\"\n)\n\n// deleteDialog holds the state of the delete-confirmation modal.\ntype deleteDialog struct {\n\talias   string       // repo being deleted\n\tconfirm dialogButton // focused button (buttonSave = Delete, buttonCancel = Cancel)\n\terr     string\n}\n\n// openDeleteDialog opens the confirmation for the selected repo.\nfunc (m *model) openDeleteDialog() {\n\tordered := orderedRepos(m.query)\n\tif m.activeTab != TabRepos || len(ordered) == 0 {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif m.repoCursor >= len(ordered) {\n\t\tm.repoCursor = len(ordered) - 1\n\t}\n\tm.deleting = true\n\tm.del = deleteDialog{\n\t\talias:   ordered[m.repoCursor].Alias,\n\t\tconfirm: buttonCancel, // default to the safe choice\n\t}\n}\n\n// closeDeleteDialog exits delete mode.\nfunc (m *model) closeDeleteDialog() {\n\tm.deleting = false\n\tm.del = deleteDialog{}\n}\n\n// updateDeleteDialog handles a key while the confirmation is open.\nfunc (m *model) updateDeleteDialog(key string) {\n\tswitch key {\n\tcase \"esc\", \"n\":\n\t\tm.closeDeleteDialog()\n\n\tcase \"left\", \"right\", \"tab\", \"shift+tab\":\n\t\tif m.del.confirm == buttonSave {\n\t\t\tm.del.confirm = buttonCancel\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tm.del.confirm = buttonSave\n\t\t}\n\n\tcase \"y\":\n\t\tm.commitDelete()\n\n\tcase \"enter\":\n\t\tif m.del.confirm == buttonCancel {\n\t\t\tm.closeDeleteDialog()\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.commitDelete()\n\t}\n}\n\n// commitDelete terminates any live session for the repo, removes it, and moves\n// the cursor to a valid position.\nfunc (m *model) commitDelete() {\n\talias := m.del.alias\n\tif repo := repos.Find(alias); repo != nil && repo.Session != nil {\n\t\t// Best-effort terminate; ignore error (session may already be gone).\n\t\t_ = commands.TerminateSession(repo.Session.ID).Run()\n\t\trepo.Session = nil\n\t}\n\n\tif err := repos.Delete(alias); err != nil {\n\t\tm.del.err = err.Error()\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tm.closeDeleteDialog()\n\n\t// Keep the cursor within bounds after removal.\n\tcount := len(orderedRepos(m.query))\n\tif m.repoCursor >= count {\n\t\tm.repoCursor = count - 1\n\t}\n\tif m.repoCursor < 0 {\n\t\tm.repoCursor = 0\n\t}\n\tm.clampScroll(count)\n}\n\n// --- rendering ---\n\nvar deleteBoxStyle = lipgloss.NewStyle().\n\tBorder(lipgloss.RoundedBorder()).\n\tBorderForeground(lipgloss.Color(\"196\")). // red border for a destructive action\n\tPadding(1, 2)\n\n// renderDeleteDialog draws the confirmation modal.\nfunc (m model) renderDeleteDialog() string {\n\ttitle := dialogTitleStyle.Render(\"Delete repo\")\n\tquestion := \"Remove \\\"\" + m.del.alias + \"\\\" from taco?\"\n\n\tcancel := buttonStyle.Render(\"Cancel\")\n\tdel := buttonStyle.Render(\"Delete\")\n\tif m.del.confirm == buttonSave {\n\t\tdel = buttonFocusedStyle.Render(\"Delete\")\n\t} else {\n\t\tcancel = buttonFocusedStyle.Render(\"Cancel\")\n\t}\n\tbuttons := lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(lipgloss.Top, cancel, del)\n\n\tparts := []string{title, \"\", question, \"\"}\n\tif m.del.err != \"\" {\n\t\tparts = append(parts, dialogErrStyle.Render(m.del.err), \"\")\n\t}\n\tparts = append(parts, buttons, \"\", Help(\"y delete · n/esc cancel · ←/→ switch · enter confirm\"))\n\n\tbody := lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Center, parts...)\n\treturn deleteBoxStyle.Render(body)\n}"
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

                "newStr": "func (m *model) moveChatCursor(delta int) {",
                "oldStr": "// --- chat delete confirmation ---\n\n// chatDeleteData holds the confirmation state for removing a chat.\ntype chatDeleteData struct {\n\tsessionID string\n\tname      string\n\tconfirm   dialogButton\n\terr       string\n}\n\n// openChatDelete opens the delete confirmation for the selected chat.\nfunc (m *model) openChatDelete() {\n\tlist := m.filteredChats()\n\tif len(list) == 0 || m.chatCursor < 0 || m.chatCursor >= len(list) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc := list[m.chatCursor]\n\tm.chatDelete = true\n\tm.chatDelData = chatDeleteData{\n\t\tsessionID: c.SessionID,\n\t\tname:      m.chatDisplayName(c),\n\t\tconfirm:   buttonCancel, // safe default\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (m *model) closeChatDelete() {\n\tm.chatDelete = false\n\tm.chatDelData = chatDeleteData{}\n}\n\n// updateChatDelete handles a key while the chat delete confirmation is open.\nfunc (m *model) updateChatDelete(key string) {\n\tswitch key {\n\tcase \"esc\", \"n\":\n\t\tm.closeChatDelete()\n\tcase \"left\", \"right\", \"tab\", \"shift+tab\":\n\t\tif m.chatDelData.confirm == buttonSave {\n\t\t\tm.chatDelData.confirm = buttonCancel\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tm.chatDelData.confirm = buttonSave\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"y\":\n\t\tm.commitChatDelete()\n\tcase \"enter\":\n\t\tif m.chatDelData.confirm == buttonCancel {\n\t\t\tm.closeChatDelete()\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.commitChatDelete()\n\t}\n}\n\n// commitChatDelete removes the chat from taco's tracking (the underlying kiro\n// session file is left untouched) and clamps the cursor.\nfunc (m *model) commitChatDelete() {\n\tif err := chats.Delete(m.chatDelData.sessionID); err != nil {\n\t\tm.chatDelData.err = err.Error()\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tm.closeChatDelete()\n\n\tcount := len(m.filteredChats())\n\tif m.chatCursor >= count {\n\t\tm.chatCursor = count - 1\n\t}\n\tif m.chatCursor < 0 {\n\t\tm.chatCursor = 0\n\t}\n}\n\n// renderChatDelete draws the chat delete confirmation modal.\nfunc (m model) renderChatDelete() string {\n\ttitle := dialogTitleStyle.Render(\"Remove chat\")\n\tquestion := \"Remove \\\"\" + m.chatDelData.name + \"\\\" from taco?\"\n\tnote := muted(\"(the kiro session file is kept)\")\n\n\tcancel := buttonStyle.Render(\"Cancel\")\n\tdel := buttonStyle.Render(\"Remove\")\n\tif m.chatDelData.confirm == buttonSave {\n\t\tdel = buttonFocusedStyle.Render(\"Remove\")\n\t} else {\n\t\tcancel = buttonFocusedStyle.Render(\"Cancel\")\n\t}\n\tbuttons := lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(lipgloss.Top, cancel, del)\n\n\tparts := []string{title, \"\", question, note, \"\"}\n\tif m.chatDelData.err != \"\" {\n\t\tparts = append(parts, dialogErrStyle.Render(m.chatDelData.err), \"\")\n\t}\n\tparts = append(parts, buttons)\n\tbody := lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Center, parts...)\n\treturn deleteBoxStyle.Render(body)\n}\n\nfunc (m *model) moveChatCursor(delta int) {",

                "command": "strReplace",
                "newStr": "// --- chat delete confirmation ---\n\n// chatDeleteData holds the confirmation state for removing a chat.\ntype chatDeleteData struct {\n\tsessionID string\n\tname      string\n\tconfirm   dialogButton\n\terr       string\n}\n\n// openChatDelete opens the delete confirmation for the selected chat.\nfunc (m *model) openChatDelete() {\n\tlist := m.filteredChats()\n\tif len(list) == 0 || m.chatCursor < 0 || m.chatCursor >= len(list) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc := list[m.chatCursor]\n\tm.chatDelete = true\n\tm.chatDelData = chatDeleteData{\n\t\tsessionID: c.SessionID,\n\t\tname:      m.chatDisplayName(c),\n\t\tconfirm:   buttonCancel, // safe default\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (m *model) closeChatDelete() {\n\tm.chatDelete = false\n\tm.chatDelData = chatDeleteData{}\n}\n\n// updateChatDelete handles a key while the chat delete confirmation is open.\nfunc (m *model) updateChatDelete(key string) {\n\tswitch key {\n\tcase \"esc\", \"n\":\n\t\tm.closeChatDelete()\n\tcase \"left\", \"right\", \"tab\", \"shift+tab\":\n\t\tif m.chatDelData.confirm == buttonSave {\n\t\t\tm.chatDelData.confirm = buttonCancel\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tm.chatDelData.confirm = buttonSave\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"y\":\n\t\tm.commitChatDelete()\n\tcase \"enter\":\n\t\tif m.chatDelData.confirm == buttonCancel {\n\t\t\tm.closeChatDelete()\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.commitChatDelete()\n\t}\n}\n\n// commitChatDelete removes the chat from taco's tracking (the underlying kiro\n// session file is left untouched) and clamps the cursor.\nfunc (m *model) commitChatDelete() {\n\tif err := chats.Delete(m.chatDelData.sessionID); err != nil {\n\t\tm.chatDelData.err = err.Error()\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tm.closeChatDelete()\n\n\tcount := len(m.filteredChats())\n\tif m.chatCursor >= count {\n\t\tm.chatCursor = count - 1\n\t}\n\tif m.chatCursor < 0 {\n\t\tm.chatCursor = 0\n\t}\n}\n\n// renderChatDelete draws the chat delete confirmation modal.\nfunc (m model) renderChatDelete() string {\n\ttitle := dialogTitleStyle.Render(\"Remove chat\")\n\tquestion := \"Remove \\\"\" + m.chatDelData.name + \"\\\" from taco?\"\n\tnote := muted(\"(the kiro session file is kept)\")\n\n\tcancel := buttonStyle.Render(\"Cancel\")\n\tdel := buttonStyle.Render(\"Remove\")\n\tif m.chatDelData.confirm == buttonSave {\n\t\tdel = buttonFocusedStyle.Render(\"Remove\")\n\t} else {\n\t\tcancel = buttonFocusedStyle.Render(\"Cancel\")\n\t}\n\tbuttons := lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(lipgloss.Top, cancel, del)\n\n\tparts := []string{title, \"\", question, note, \"\"}\n\tif m.chatDelData.err != \"\" {\n\t\tparts = append(parts, dialogErrStyle.Render(m.chatDelData.err), \"\")\n\t}\n\tparts = append(parts, buttons)\n\tbody := lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Center, parts...)\n\treturn deleteBoxStyle.Render(body)\n}\n\nfunc (m *model) moveChatCursor(delta int) {\n\tcount := len(m.filteredChats())\n\tnext := m.chatCursor + delta\n\tif next >= 0 && next < count {\n\t\tm.chatCursor = next\n\t}",

                "path": "/Users/egriham/repos/misc/taco/ui/chats_tab.go"

                "command": "go build ./... 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== vet ===\"; go vet ./... 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== fmt ===\"; gofmt -l .\ncat > ui/zz_chatdel_test.go <<'EOF'\npackage ui\n\nimport (\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/chats\"\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/provider\"\n)\n\nfunc TestChatDeleteConfirmAndCancel(t *testing.T) {\n\thome := t.TempDir(); os.Setenv(\"HOME\", home)\n\tsess := filepath.Join(home, \".kiro\", \"sessions\", \"cli\")\n\tos.MkdirAll(sess, 0755)\n\t// A real session file to confirm it's NOT deleted.\n\tsf := filepath.Join(sess, \"id-1.json\")\n\tos.WriteFile(sf, []byte(`{\"session_id\":\"id-1\"}`), 0644)\n\n\tchats.Init()\n\tchats.Add(\"Alpha\", \"id-1\", \"worker\")\n\tchats.Add(\"Beta\", \"id-2\", \"analyzer\")\n\n\tm := model{activeTab: TabChats, provider: provider.NewKiro()}\n\n\t// Default focus is Cancel.\n\tm.openChatDelete()\n\tif m.chatDelData.confirm != buttonCancel { t.Fatal(\"default should be Cancel\") }\n\ttarget := m.chatDelData.sessionID\n\t// Cancel keeps it.\n\tm.updateChatDelete(\"n\")\n\tif chats.FindByID(target) == nil { t.Fatal(\"cancel should keep chat\") }\n\n\t// Confirm removes it.\n\tm.openChatDelete()\n\tm.updateChatDelete(\"y\")\n\tif m.chatDelete { t.Fatal(\"dialog should close\") }\n\tif chats.FindByID(target) != nil { t.Fatalf(\"chat %s should be removed\", target) }\n\tif len(chats.All()) != 1 { t.Fatalf(\"expected 1 left, got %d\", len(chats.All())) }\n\t// kiro session file must remain.\n\tif _, err := os.Stat(sf); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"kiro session file should be kept: %v\", err)\n\t}\n}\nEOF\ngo test ./ui/ -run TestChatDeleteConfirmAndCancel -v 2>&1 | tail -6\nrm -f ui/zz_chatdel_test.go",
                "working_dir": "/Users/egriham/repos/misc/taco"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }

          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Rename for chats — same pattern. `Ctrl+R` already renames repos, so I'll make it tab-aware. One thing to be clear about given our source-of-truth discussion: the display name prefers the **live kiro title**. So renaming a chat sets taco's stored fallback name, but if kiro has a live title, that title still wins in the display.\n\nThat's a real UX wrinkle worth deciding: if you rename a chat to \"My deploy\" but kiro's title is \"Deploy pipeline\", the table will still show \"Deploy pipeline\" (live title wins). Two options:\n\n1. **Rename sets the stored fallback only** — consistent with the current model, but your rename may appear to \"not take\" if kiro has a title.\n2. **A renamed chat's stored name overrides the live title** — i.e. once you explicitly rename, taco shows your name regardless of kiro's title.\n\nFor a rename feature to feel like it works, **option 2** is what users expect — an explicit rename should stick and be shown. I'll implement it so that if a chat has a user-set name, `chatDisplayName` prefers it over the live title. I'll need a flag to distinguish \"auto-captured name\" from \"user-renamed name.\"\n\nLet me confirm this is what you want before building: **should renaming a chat make your name take precedence over kiro's live title?** (I recommend yes — otherwise rename looks broken.) Assuming yes, I'll add a \"renamed\" flag to the chat entry (persisted), and `chatDisplayName` prefers the stored name when that flag is set.\n\nWant me to go with that (rename overrides live title), or keep it as a fallback-only rename?"
          }
        ]
      }

          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Now add the chat-rename logic and rendering to `chats_tab.go`, modeled on the repo rename dialog (input + Save/Cancel buttons):"
          },
          {
            "kind": "toolUse",
            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "toolu_bdrk_013WFKCQAspfF79Z77UArN54",
              "name": "write",
              "input": {
                "__tool_use_purpose": "Add chat-rename modal: state, open/close, key handling, commit, rendering.",
                "command": "strReplace",
                "newStr": "// --- chat rename ---\n\n// chatRenameData holds the state of the chat rename modal.\ntype chatRenameData struct {\n\tsessionID string\n\tinput     string\n\tfocus     dialogButton\n\terr       string\n}\n\n// openChatRename opens the rename dialog for the selected chat, seeded with its\n// current display name.\nfunc (m *model) openChatRename() {\n\tlist := m.filteredChats()\n\tif len(list) == 0 || m.chatCursor < 0 || m.chatCursor >= len(list) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc := list[m.chatCursor]\n\tm.chatRename = true\n\tm.chatRenData = chatRenameData{\n\t\tsessionID: c.SessionID,\n\t\tinput:     m.chatDisplayName(c),\n\t\tfocus:     buttonSave,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (m *model) closeChatRename() {\n\tm.chatRename = false\n\tm.chatRenData = chatRenameData{}\n}\n\n// updateChatRename handles a key while the chat rename dialog is open.\nfunc (m *model) updateChatRename(key string) {\n\tswitch key {\n\tcase \"esc\":\n\t\tm.closeChatRename()\n\tcase \"left\", \"right\", \"tab\", \"shift+tab\":\n\t\tif m.chatRenData.focus == buttonSave {\n\t\t\tm.chatRenData.focus = buttonCancel\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tm.chatRenData.focus = buttonSave\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"enter\":\n\t\tif m.chatRenData.focus == buttonCancel {\n\t\t\tm.closeChatRename()\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.commitChatRename()\n\tcase \"backspace\":\n\t\tif m.chatRenData.input != \"\" {\n\t\t\tm.chatRenData.input = m.chatRenData.input[:len(m.chatRenData.input)-1]\n\t\t}\n\tdefault:\n\t\tif len(key) == 1 && key[0] >= 0x20 && key[0] < 0x7f {\n\t\t\tm.chatRenData.input += key\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// commitChatRename persists the new name (marking the chat as user-renamed).\nfunc (m *model) commitChatRename() {\n\tif err := chats.Rename(m.chatRenData.sessionID, m.chatRenData.input); err != nil {\n\t\tm.chatRenData.err = err.Error()\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tm.closeChatRename()\n}\n\n// renderChatRename draws the chat rename modal.\nfunc (m model) renderChatRename() string {\n\ttitle := dialogTitleStyle.Render(\"Rename chat\")\n\n\tinputWidth := lipgloss.Width(m.chatRenData.input) + 12\n\tif inputWidth < 24 {\n\t\tinputWidth = 24\n\t}\n\tinput := dialogInputStyle.Width(inputWidth).Render(m.chatRenData.input + \"▏\")\n\n\tsave := buttonStyle.Render(\"Save\")\n\tcancel := buttonStyle.Render(\"Cancel\")\n\tif m.chatRenData.focus == buttonSave {\n\t\tsave = buttonFocusedStyle.Render(\"Save\")\n\t} else {\n\t\tcancel = buttonFocusedStyle.Render(\"Cancel\")\n\t}\n\tbuttons := lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(lipgloss.Top, save, cancel)\n\n\tparts := []string{title, \"\", input, \"\"}\n\tif m.chatRenData.err != \"\" {\n\t\tparts = append(parts, dialogErrStyle.Render(m.chatRenData.err), \"\")\n\t}\n\tparts = append(parts, buttons)\n\tbody := lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Center, parts...)\n\treturn dialogBoxStyle.Render(body)\n}\n\nfunc (m *model) moveChatCursor(delta int) {",
                "oldStr": "func (m *model) moveChatCursor(delta int) {",
                "path": "/Users/egriham/repos/misc/taco/ui/chats_tab.go"

                "__tool_use_purpose": "Build/vet/fmt and verify: rename sets Renamed, display prefers user name over live title, persists, and format round-trips.",
                "command": "go build ./... 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== vet ===\"; go vet ./... 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== fmt ===\"; gofmt -l .\ncat > ui/zz_chatrename_test.go <<'EOF'\npackage ui\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/chats\"\n\t\"github.com/hampusgrimskar/taco/provider\"\n)\n\nfunc TestChatRenameOverridesLiveTitle(t *testing.T) {\n\thome := t.TempDir(); os.Setenv(\"HOME\", home)\n\tsess := filepath.Join(home, \".kiro\", \"sessions\", \"cli\")\n\tos.MkdirAll(sess, 0755)\n\t// Session file WITH a live title.\n\tmeta := map[string]any{\"session_id\": \"id-1\", \"title\": \"Kiro Title\", \"cwd\": \"/x\"}\n\tb, _ := json.Marshal(meta)\n\tos.WriteFile(filepath.Join(sess, \"id-1.json\"), b, 0644)\n\n\tchats.Init()\n\tchats.Add(\"captured\", \"id-1\", \"worker\")\n\n\tm := model{activeTab: TabChats, provider: provider.NewKiro()}\n\tc := chats.FindByID(\"id-1\")\n\n\t// Before rename: live title wins.\n\tif got := m.chatDisplayName(c); got != \"Kiro Title\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected live title before rename, got %q\", got)\n\t}\n\n\t// Rename.\n\tm.chatRenData = chatRenameData{sessionID: \"id-1\", input: \"My Name\", focus: buttonSave}\n\tm.chatRename = true\n\tm.commitChatRename()\n\tif m.chatRename { t.Fatal(\"dialog should close\") }\n\n\tc = chats.FindByID(\"id-1\")\n\tif !c.Renamed || c.Name != \"My Name\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"rename not applied: %+v\", c)\n\t}\n\t// After rename: user name overrides live title.\n\tif got := m.chatDisplayName(c); got != \"My Name\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected user name after rename, got %q\", got)\n\t}\n\n\t// Persists with renamed flag.\n\tchats.Instance = nil\n\tchats.Init()\n\tc = chats.FindByID(\"id-1\")\n\tif c == nil || !c.Renamed || c.Name != \"My Name\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"rename not persisted: %+v\", c)\n\t}\n}\nEOF\ngo test ./ui/ -run TestChatRenameOverridesLiveTitle -v 2>&1 | tail -6\nrm -f ui/zz_chatrename_test.go",
                "working_dir": "/Users/egriham/repos/misc/taco"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    },

            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Fixed and verified: both rename inputs now accept spaces — the chat rename produces `\"a b c\"` and the repo rename produces `\"foo bar\"`, confirming both `\" \"` and the `\"space\"` key string are handled.\n\nThe root cause was that the spacebar can arrive as the multi-character string `\"space\"` (not just `\" \"`), which failed the `len(key) == 1` printable-char check and got dropped. I added an explicit `case \" \", \"space\":` that appends a space in both the chat rename and repo rename dialogs.\n\nBuilds, vets, gofmt-clean. Run `go run .` → Chats tab → `Ctrl+R` and you'll be able to type spaces in the name now."
